# file opened: zpolice.asm
   1  0000              ;==============================================================================
   2  0000              ; Z-POLICE  -  3D vector city flight for the ZX Spectrum Next
   3  0000              ;
   4  0000              ;  Z80N assembler (sjasmplus --zxnext).  Layer 2 256x192x8bpp, double buffered.
   5  0000              ;  The 3D viewport is the top 256x128; the bottom third is an instrument panel.
   6  0000              ;  Maths: world positions are 16-bit integers (one city cell = 256 units),
   7  0000              ;         trig values are S7.8 fixed point (1.0 = $0100).
   8  0000              ;  Hidden line removal: painter's algorithm. Buildings are walked over the
   9  0000              ;  grid far-to-near (no sort needed). Each visible face is filled in its
  10  0000              ;  shade (roof lighter, side turned away darker) and optionally outlined, so
  11  0000              ;  nearer buildings overwrite those behind them. Faces with every corner on
  12  0000              ;  screen use cached projections; faces crossing the view frustum are
  13  0000              ;  clipped in 3D (Sutherland-Hodgman, 5 planes). Rasterisation then only
  14  0000              ;  ever sees on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
  15  0000              ;
  16  0000              ;  Controls: Q/A speed up/down   Z air brake O/P turn left/right
  17  0000              ;            W/S climb/descend   E/D nose up/down
  18  0000              ;            SPACE fire          1-5 select weapon slot
  19  0000              ;            0 change the centre slot's weapon
  20  0000              ;
  21  0000              ;  Source files: zpolice.asm (resident main code), memory_bank_defs.asm
  22  0000              ;  (slots and pages).  Game logic pages, swapped into slot 6 at $C000:
  23  0000              ;  player.asm (input/movement), weapons.asm, menu.asm (main menu).  Core
  24  0000              ;  function pages, swapped into slot 7 at $E000: city.asm (Layer 2
  25  0000              ;  drawing), hud.asm (ULA HUD), input.asm (redefinable keys, joysticks), sprites.asm
  26  0000              ;  (hardware sprites).  Always mapped: zombie.asm at $2000, human.asm and
  27  0000              ;  map.asm (the city map) at $7000.
  28  0000              ;
  29  0000              ;  Memory while running:
  30  0000              ;    $0000-$1FFF  Layer 2 back buffer, one 8K section at a time (slot 0)
  31  0000              ;    $2000-$3FFF  zombie page (slot 1)
  32  0000              ;    $4000-$7FFF  occlusion data; cell colours, humans, map (slots 2-3)
  33  0000              ;    $8000-$9FFF  ULA screen (slot 4)
  34  0000              ;    $A000-$BFFF  resident code, tables, variables, stack (slot 5)
  35  0000              ;    $C000-$DFFF  game logic page (slot 6)
  36  0000              ;    $E000-$FFFF  core function page (slot 7)
  37  0000              ;==============================================================================
  38  0000
  39  0000                      DEVICE ZXSPECTRUMNEXT
  40  0000                      SLDOPT COMMENT WPMEM, LOGPOINT, ASSERTION
  41  0000                      CSPECTMAP zpolice.map
  42  0000                      OPT --zxnext=cspect --syntax=a --reversepop
  43  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  44  0000              ; Build options
  45  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  46  0000              ; DRAW_LINES: outline building faces with EDGE_COL vectors.  Comment it out for solid-colour buildings only; the HUD
  47  0000              ; is always drawn.  Can also be set from the command line: -DDRAW_LINES
  48  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_LINES
  49  0000
  50  0000              ; WAIT_FOR_VBLANK: wait for the raster to leave the display area before
  51  0000              ; flipping the Layer 2 buffers (no tearing).  Comment it out to flip as soon
  52  0000              ; as a frame is drawn: faster, but the flip may tear mid-screen.
  53  0000              ; Command line: -DWAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  54  0000                      ;DEFINE WAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  55  0000
  56  0000              ; DRAW_FPS: measure frames per second from the raster (vtick) and show it at
  57  0000              ; the top left of the ULA screen.  Comment it out to drop the measuring and
  58  0000              ; the display.  Command line: -DDRAW_FPS
  59  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_FPS
  60  0000
  61  0000              ; SKY_IS_WALL: the camera can never rise above the perimeter wall, so fill
  62  0000              ; the sky in the wall's colour and draw wall cells only up to camera height
  63  0000              ; (their top edge is then exactly the horizon).  No sky is ever seen.
  64  0000              ; Command line: -DSKY_IS_WALL
  65  0000                      DEFINE SKY_IS_WALL
  66  0000
  67  0000              ; OCCLUSION_CULL: in level flight, record the buildings, then cull those
  68  0000              ; completely hidden behind nearer ones (a per-column cover buffer, front to
  69  0000              ; back) before drawing the rest.  Uses pages PAGE_OCC0/1 at $4000-$7FFF.
  70  0000              ; Command line: -DOCCLUSION_CULL
  71  0000                      DEFINE OCCLUSION_CULL
  72  0000
  73  0000              ; LEVEL_FAST_PATH: while pitch is 0 (level flight) a building's top corners
  74  0000              ; have the same camera X and Z as the bottom corners below them, so each top
  75  0000              ; corner reuses its bottom corner's screen x and 1/Z and only works out its
  76  0000              ; screen y.  Comment it out to project every corner in full.
  77  0000              ; Command line: -DLEVEL_FAST_PATH
  78  0000                      DEFINE LEVEL_FAST_PATH
  79  0000
  80  0000              ; CLIP_2D: a face that crosses only the screen's sides, top or bottom, and is
  81  0000              ; within a guard band (|X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z), has its corners projected to
  82  0000              ; 16-bit screen coordinates and is clipped against the screen in 2D, not in
  83  0000              ; 3D (no new points to project, one multiply per new point, not three).
  84  0000              ; Faces crossing the near plane, or outside the guard band, are clipped in
  85  0000              ; 3D as before.  Comment it out to clip every face in 3D.
  86  0000              ; Command line: -DCLIP_2D
  87  0000                      DEFINE CLIP_2D
  88  0000

# file opened: memory_bank_defs.asm
   1+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 0000              ; Z-POLICE - memory bank definitions
   3+ 0000              ;
   4+ 0000              ; The Next maps its RAM into the Z80's 64K as eight 8K MMU slots, each set by
   5+ 0000              ; a NextReg ($50-$57) to an 8K page (page n = half of 16K bank n/2).  This
   6+ 0000              ; file names the slots, their registers and addresses, what each slot is
   7+ 0000              ; used for, and which page holds what.  Use:
   8+ 0000              ;   nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_CITY            ; page the city code in at $E000
   9+ 0000              ;   MMU CODE_SLOT e, PAGE_CITY, CODE_ADDR ; (sjasmplus) assemble into it
  10+ 0000              ;
  11+ 0000              ; Memory map (see README.md):
  12+ 0000              ;   slot 0 $0000  Layer 2 sections (32 rows each) while drawing; the sine
  13+ 0000              ;                 table (PAGE_SIN) whenever get_sin reads it
  14+ 0000              ;   slot 1 $2000  zombie page, always mapped: zombies, humans, the HUD
  15+ 0000              ;                 map, the IM 2 table
  16+ 0000              ;   slot 2 $4000  occlusion data
  17+ 0000              ;   slot 3 $6000  the city bank (always mapped): city_col at $6000,
  18+ 0000              ;                 city_map at $7000, loaded from the level's city file
  19+ 0000              ;   slot 4 $8000  ULA screen (page 10, the first half of bank 5)
  20+ 0000              ;   slot 5 $A000  resident main code, variables, stack (page 11, the unused
  21+ 0000              ;                 second half of bank 5)
  22+ 0000              ;   slot 6 $C000  game logic pages, swapped: player, weapons, menu, level
  23+ 0000              ;                 loading
  24+ 0000              ;   slot 7 $E000  core function pages, swapped: city (Layer 2 drawing), HUD,
  25+ 0000              ;                 keys, sprites; a sprite bank while it is loaded; the
  26+ 0000              ;                 start-up set-up (initialise.asm) once
  27+ 0000              ; So game logic in slot 6 can call any core page in slot 7: main_loop pages
  28+ 0000              ; the keys in at $E000 while the player and weapons pages run at $C000.
  29+ 0000              ; At start-up the NEX loader's default mapping is in place (slot 6 = page
  30+ 0000              ; 0), so the entry point is a stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000 (boot, zpolice.asm)
  31+ 0000              ; that maps the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.
  32+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
  33+ 0000
  34+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  35+ 0000              ; MMU slots: number, NextReg, address
  36+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  37+ 0000              MEMBANK_SIZE            equ $2000       ; 8K a slot / page
  38+ 0000
  39+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0              equ 0
  40+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1              equ 1
  41+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2              equ 2
  42+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3              equ 3
  43+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4              equ 4
  44+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5              equ 5
  45+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6              equ 6
  46+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7              equ 7
  47+ 0000
  48+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER     equ $50
  49+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER     equ $51
  50+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER     equ $52
  51+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER     equ $53
  52+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER     equ $54
  53+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER     equ $55
  54+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER     equ $56
  55+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER     equ $57
  56+ 0000
  57+ 0000              membank0                equ $0000
  58+ 0000              membank1                equ $2000
  59+ 0000              membank2                equ $4000
  60+ 0000              membank3                equ $6000
  61+ 0000              membank4                equ $8000
  62+ 0000              membank5                equ $A000
  63+ 0000              membank6                equ $C000
  64+ 0000              membank7                equ $E000
  65+ 0000
  66+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  67+ 0000              ; What each slot is used for: <use>_SLOT, <use>_MMU (its NextReg) and
  68+ 0000              ; <use>_ADDR (the ORG of code or data assembled for it)
  69+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  70+ 0000              ; slot 0: one 32-row section of a Layer 2 buffer at a time (seg_map etc.)
  71+ 0000              L2SEC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_0
  72+ 0000              L2SEC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  73+ 0000              L2SEC_ADDR              equ membank0
  74+ 0000              ; slot 0 also: the sine table, paged in by get_sin (resident).  Only the
  75+ 0000              ; game logic calls it, never the drawing, and every Layer 2 writer maps its
  76+ 0000              ; own section first, so the two never meet.  Nothing may write to
  77+ 0000              ; $0000-$1FFF while it is mapped.
  78+ 0000              SIN_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_0
  79+ 0000              SIN_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  80+ 0000              SIN_ADDR                equ membank0
  81+ 0000
  82+ 0000              ; slot 1: zombie.asm, human.asm, map.asm, interrupts.asm, always mapped
  83+ 0000              ZOMBIE_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_1
  84+ 0000              ZOMBIE_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER
  85+ 0000              ZOMBIE_ADDR             equ membank1
  86+ 0000
  87+ 0000              ; slot 2: occlusion buffer, draw list and building records (OCCLUSION_CULL)
  88+ 0000              OCC_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_2
  89+ 0000              OCC_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  90+ 0000              OCC_ADDR                equ membank2
  91+ 0000
  92+ 0000              ; slot 3: the city bank, always mapped: city_col at $6000, city_map at
  93+ 0000              ; $7000, read from the level's city file (level_load.asm) in one go
  94+ 0000              TABLES_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_3
  95+ 0000              TABLES_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER
  96+ 0000              TABLES_ADDR             equ membank3            ; city_col
  97+ 0000              CITYMAP_ADDR            equ membank3+$1000      ; city_map
  98+ 0000
  99+ 0000              ; slot 4: the ULA screen (bank 5's first 8K: bitmap and attributes)
 100+ 0000              ULA_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_4
 101+ 0000              ULA_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 102+ 0000              ULA_ADDR                equ membank4
 103+ 0000              ; slot 4 also: the second city page (city2.asm), over the ULA screen while
 104+ 0000              ; main_loop draws the city (nothing then uses the ULA screen)
 105+ 0000              CITY2_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_4
 106+ 0000              CITY2_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 107+ 0000              CITY2_ADDR              equ membank4
 108+ 0000
 109+ 0000              ; slot 5: resident main code (zpolice.asm), tables, variables, stack
 110+ 0000              MAIN_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_5
 111+ 0000              MAIN_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER
 112+ 0000              MAIN_ADDR               equ membank5
 113+ 0000
 114+ 0000              ; slot 6: game logic pages, swapped (player, weapons, menu)
 115+ 0000              LOGIC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_6
 116+ 0000              LOGIC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER
 117+ 0000              LOGIC_ADDR              equ membank6
 118+ 0000              ; slot 6 at start-up: the boot stub (the NEX loader maps page 0 there)
 119+ 0000              BOOT_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_6
 120+ 0000              BOOT_ADDR               equ membank6
 121+ 0000
 122+ 0000              ; slot 7: core function pages, swapped (city / Layer 2, HUD, keys, sprites)
 123+ 0000              CODE_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_7
 124+ 0000              CODE_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 125+ 0000              CODE_ADDR               equ membank7
 126+ 0000              ; slot 7 also: a sprite pattern bank (sprite_data.asm), paged in to run
 127+ 0000              ; its own loader, spr_load_bank
 128+ 0000              SPRBANK_SLOT            equ MMU_SLOT_7
 129+ 0000              SPRBANK_MMU             equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 130+ 0000              SPRBANK_ADDR            equ membank7
 131+ 0000
 132+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 133+ 0000              ; 8K pages
 134+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 135+ 0000              PAGE_BOOT               equ 0           ; the NEX entry stub (slot 6 at load)
 136+ 0000              PAGE_CITY               equ 1           ; city.asm: Layer 2 drawing (slot 7)
 137+ 0000              PAGE_HUD                equ 2           ; hud.asm: ULA (Layer 1) HUD (slot 7)
 138+ 0000              PAGE_PLAYER             equ 3           ; player.asm: input, movement,
 139+ 0000                                                      ; collision (slot 6)
 140+ 0000              PAGE_WEAPONS            equ 4           ; weapons.asm: player weapons (slot 6)
 141+ 0000              PAGE_ZOMBIE             equ 5           ; zombie.asm (slot 1, always)
 142+ 0000              PAGE_OCC0               equ 6           ; occlusion buffer, draw list and
 143+ 0000                                                      ; building records (slot 2)
 144+ 0000              PAGE_OCC1               equ 7           ; the city bank: city_col and
 145+ 0000                                                      ; city_map (slot 3, always)
 146+ 0000              PAGE_MENU               equ 8           ; menu.asm: main menu (slot 6)
 147+ 0000              PAGE_SPR0               equ 9           ; sprite_data.asm: sprite pattern
 148+ 0000                                                      ; bank 0 (slot 7 while loading);
 149+ 0000                                                      ; more banks: the next free pages
 150+ 0000              PAGE_ULA0               equ 10          ; the ULA screen, bank 5 (slot 4)
 151+ 0000              PAGE_MAIN               equ 11          ; zpolice.asm, resident (slot 5): the
 152+ 0000                                                      ; second half of bank 5
 153+ 0000              PAGE_INPUT              equ 12          ; input.asm: keyboard, joysticks (slot 7)
 154+ 0000              PAGE_SPRITES            equ 13          ; sprites.asm: hardware sprites
 155+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 7)
 156+ 0000              PAGE_SIN                equ 14          ; sin_tables.asm: the sine table
 157+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 0, read by get_sin)
 158+ 0000              PAGE_INIT               equ 15          ; initialise.asm: start-up set-up,
 159+ 0000                                                      ; initgame (slot 7, once)
 160+ 0000              PAGE_FILE               equ 16          ; file_handler.asm: SD card loading
 161+ 0000                                                      ; and saving (slot 7)
 162+ 0000              PAGE_AUDIO              equ 17          ; audio.asm: sound set-up (slot 7)
 163+ 0000              PAGE_SPECIAL            equ 31          ; specials.asm: special monsters
 164+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 6)
 165+ 0000              PAGE_LOADOUT            equ 32          ; loadout.asm: the load-out screen
 166+ 0000                                                      ; between levels (slot 6)
 167+ 0000              PAGE_KEYDEF             equ 33          ; keydef.asm: the redefine keys
 168+ 0000                                                      ; screen (slot 6)
 169+ 0000              PAGE_CITY2              equ 34          ; city2.asm: more Layer 2 drawing
 170+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 4, with the city page)
 171+ 0000              PAGE_GFX0               equ 35          ; the figures' graphics (pages 35 to
 172+ 0000                                                      ; 35+GFX_PAGES_MAX-1), loaded from
 173+ 0000                                                      ; ZPDATA/SPRITES.ZPG at start-up; each
 174+ 0000                                                      ; mapped at $C000 (slot 6) to draw
 175+ 0000              PAGE_LEVEL              equ 30          ; level_load.asm: level and city
 176+ 0000                                                      ; files (slot 6); pages 18-29 are
 177+ 0000                                                      ; the Layer 2 buffers
 178+ 0000
 179+ 0000              ; Layer 2 double buffer, in 16K banks (NextReg $12 / $13 take banks; the
 180+ 0000              ; pages are bank * 2).  Layer 2 is clipped to 192 rows, so each buffer
 181+ 0000              ; uses three banks.
 182+ 0000              L2_BANK_A               equ 9           ; 16K banks 9-11 (pages 18-23)
 183+ 0000              L2_BANK_B               equ 12          ; 16K banks 12-14 (pages 24-29)
 184+ 0000              PAGE_L2_A               equ L2_BANK_A*2
 185+ 0000              PAGE_L2_B               equ L2_BANK_B*2
 186+ 0000
 187+ 0000              PAGE_ROM                equ $FF         ; MMU value: ROM in slots 0-1

  91  0000
  92  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  93  0000              ; Tuning constants
  94  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  95  0000              ; Scale: one map tile (cell) is 20 m x 20 m = 256 world units, and one
  96  0000              ; height unit (building heights, the ceiling, the pad) is 10 m = 128 world
  97  0000              ; units.  World units are the same size on every axis, so 1 m = 12.8 units
  98  0000              ; and 1 unit = 7.8 cm.  The city is 64 x 64 tiles = 1280 m.
  99  0000              ; Speeds are per rendered frame, so real speed depends on the frame rate
 100  0000              ; (figures below are at 14 fps).
 101  0000              GRID            equ 64          ; the city is GRID x GRID tiles (gentables.py)
 102  0000              ; A city_map byte: bits 0-4 the cell code (0 road, 1-15 building height
 103  0000              ; level, PAD_CODE, TERRACE_CODE, VOID_CODE: out of bounds), bit 6 set while a human waits in the cell
 104  0000              ; (human.asm, hum_flags), bit 7 while a zombie or special monster stands in
 105  0000              ; it (zombie.asm, zflags; its type is in its record).  Bit 5 is free.  So
 106  0000              ; every reader masks with CELL_CODE before testing for road or a code.
 107  0000              CELL_CODE       equ %00011111
 108  0000              CELL_FLAGS      equ %11100000       ; (the marks, kept when the code changes)
 109  0000              CELL_HUMAN_B    equ 6
 110  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE_B   equ 7
 111  0000              CELL_HUMAN      equ 1<<CELL_HUMAN_B
 112  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE     equ 1<<CELL_ZOMBIE_B
 113  0000              TILE_M          equ 20          ; metres per tile (reference scale)
 114  0000              TILE_UNITS      equ 256         ; world units per tile
 115  0000              HEIGHT_M        equ 10          ; metres per height unit
 116  0000              HEIGHT_UNITS    equ 128         ; world units per height unit
 117  0000              NEAR            equ 16          ; near clip plane: 1.25 m
 118  0000              VIEW_R          equ 8           ; most draw distance: buildings within +/- 8
 119  0000                                              ; tiles (160 m).  Each level sets its own,
 120  0000                                              ; 2..VIEW_R (view_r; night, fog), and the
 121  0000                                              ; street dots' radius one less (dot_r)
 122  0000              PMAX            equ 24          ; pitch limit (256 = 360 deg) - match gentables.py
 123  0000              SPEED_MAX       equ 28          ; units/frame: 2.2 m/frame, ~31 m/s (110 km/h)
 124  0000              SPEED_MIN       equ -6          ; reverse: 0.47 m/frame, ~6.6 m/s
 125  0000              YAW_RATE        equ $0180       ; turn per frame, 8.8 fixed (1.5 units;
 126  0000                                              ; 256 units = 360 degrees)
 127  0000              YAW_FINE        equ 256*256/360 ; the first frame of a turn: 1 degree
 128  0000                                              ; (182: 0.711 units, 8.8 fixed)
 129  0000              CLIMB_RATE      equ 4           ; units/frame: 0.31 m/frame, ~4.4 m/s
 130  0000              SPEED_STEP      equ 1           ; Q / A: speed change a frame, units/frame
 131  0000                                              ; (1.1 m/s; player.asm uses inc / dec)
 132  0000                      ASSERT SPEED_STEP == 1
 133  0000              ; Air brake (Z): the speed falls by twice the Q / A step every frame, to 0
 134  0000              AIRBRAKE_STEP   equ 2*SPEED_STEP    ; 2 units/frame (2.2 m/s)
 135  0000              ; Booster module (a salvage reward, fitted at once: boost_fitted).  The
 136  0000              ; boost control (K_BOOST, X) puts the speed straight to BOOST_SPEED, twice
 137  0000              ; SPEED_MAX, if going forwards at BOOST_MIN or more with fuel left; again,
 138  0000              ; or out of fuel, puts back the speed it had (boost_spd).  Q, A and Z don't
 139  0000              ; change the speed while boosting.  Each boosted frame burns 1 fuel
 140  0000              ; (boost_fuel, at most BOOST_FUEL_MAX); landed on the pad it refuels 1 a
 141  0000              ; frame (pad_service).  HUD: the B gauge, and the speed bar amber.
 142  0000              BOOST_SPEED     equ 2*SPEED_MAX     ; 56 units/frame
 143  0000              BOOST_MIN       equ SPEED_MAX/2     ; 14: at least half speed, forwards
 144  0000              BOOST_FUEL_MAX  equ 200
 145  0000                      ASSERT BOOST_SPEED < 128 && BOOST_FUEL_MAX < 256
 146  0000              ; Pitch damper: with neither E nor D held, the nose eases back to level.
 147  0000              ; Every PDAMP_FRAMES frames the 8.8 pitch moves towards 0 by
 148  0000              ; max(PDAMP_MIN, |pitch| * PDAMP_K) in 1/256ths of a pitch unit.  With
 149  0000              ; PDAMP_K 0 that is a steady PDAMP_MIN a frame: half a pitch unit, half the
 150  0000              ; rate of the nose keys (1 unit a frame), however far it is from level.  (A
 151  0000              ; PDAMP_K above 0 adds a share of what is left, faster when far off: 43, as
 152  0000              ; it was, returned up to 4 units a frame from full pitch.)
 153  0000              PDAMP_FRAMES    equ 1           ; frames between damping steps
 154  0000              PDAMP_K         equ 0           ; no share: a steady rate
 155  0000              PDAMP_MIN       equ 128         ; 128/256: half a pitch unit a frame
 156  0000              MIN_Y           equ 8           ; lowest flight: 0.6 m
 157  0000              MAX_Y           equ 3*HEIGHT_UNITS/2  ; ceiling 1.5 height units: 15 m
 158  0000              MAX_Y_THRUST    equ 3*HEIGHT_UNITS  ; with the vertical thrusters (a salvage
 159  0000                                              ; reward, vthrust_fitted): 3.0 height units, 30 m
 160  0000              BLD_MAX_H       equ 7*HEIGHT_UNITS  ; tallest building 7.0 height units: 70 m
 161  0000                                              ; (htab level 15, gentables.py; 4.7 m a level)
 162  0000                      ASSERT MAX_Y_THRUST < BLD_MAX_H ; (below the perimeter wall: SKY_IS_WALL)
 163  0000              WORLD_MIN       equ 64
 164  0000              WORLD_MAX       equ GRID*256-64
 165  0000              DMA_SPAN_MIN    equ 20          ; spans this wide or wider are filled by DMA
 166  0000              ; The VTOL (the player's craft): 10 m long by 3 m wide.  Its position

 535  0000
 536  0000              ; Screen split: the 3D viewport is Layer 2, top two thirds (256x128, rows
 537  0000              ; 0-127).  The bottom third (rows 128-191) is an instrument panel drawn on the
 538  0000              ; ULA (Layer 1), which sits above Layer 2.  The ULA screen (bank 5) stays
 539  0000              ; paged in at $8000 (slot 4): bitmap ULA_BMP, attributes ULA_ATTR.
 540  0000              VIEW_H          equ 128         ; viewport height
 541  0000              VIEW_CY         equ 64          ; viewport centre row
 542  0000              ULA_BMP         equ $8000
 543  0000              ULA_ATTR        equ $9800
 544  0000
 545  0000              ; ULA palette indices used by the panel (custom colours set in ula_init)
 546  0000              P_PANEL         equ 1           ; paper: panel background
 547  0000              C_WARN          equ 3           ; ink/paper: red (reversing)
 548  0000              C_OK            equ 4           ; ink/paper: green
 549  0000              C_YEL           equ 2           ; ink: yellow (weapon slot flash)
 550  0000              C_BLUE          equ 5           ; ink: light blue
 551  0000              C_AMBER         equ 6           ; ink/paper: amber (weapon slot flash)
 552  0000              ATTR_PANEL      equ P_PANEL<<3 | 7
 553  0000
 554  0000              ; Gauges: vertical bars on Layer 2 behind transparent ULA cells, filled
 555  0000              ; from the bottom, pixel rows GAUGE_TOP..GAUGE_TOP+GAUGE_H-1 (character rows
 556  0000              ; 17-22), labelled on character row 23.  Speed ("S") is 8 pixels wide at
 557  0000              ; character column SPD_GCOL; altitude and ground height ("A") share the cell

 596  0000              ; HL = HL * GRID  (a map row offset)
 597  0000                      MACRO ROWOFS
 598  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 599  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 600  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 601  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 602  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 603  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 604  0000                      ENDM
 605  0000
 606  0000              ; A building's 8 corners (vtx, 16 bytes each; index = x + 2*z + 4*top) from
 607  0000              ; corner 0, component C (0 X, 2 Y, 4 Z) at a time: v1 = v0 + vx, v3 = v1 +
 608  0000              ; vz, v2 = v0 + vz (vx, vz: vecs0, its edge vectors), and each top corner
 609  0000              ; its bottom corner + vy (vy_vec, the vertical edge).  The sums the corners
 610  0000              ; share are made once, in registers (draw_bld, city.asm).
 611  0000                      MACRO VBOX C
 612  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 613  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)                 ; vx
 614  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)               ; vz
 615  0000 ~                    push hl
 616  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 617  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 618  0000 ~                    push hl
 619  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 620  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 621  0000 ~                    ld de,(vy_vec+C)                ; vy
 622  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 623  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7 = v3 + vy
 624  0000 ~                    pop hl
 625  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 626  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5 = v1 + vy
 627  0000 ~                    pop hl
 628  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 629  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 630  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 631  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6 = v2 + vy
 632  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)
 633  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 634  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0 + vy
 635  0000                      ENDM
 636  0000              ; The same for a component of vy that is 0 (X always; Z in level flight):
 637  0000              ; each top corner is its bottom corner
 638  0000                      MACRO VBOX0 C
 639  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 640  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0
 641  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)
 642  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)
 643  0000 ~                    push hl
 644  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 645  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 646  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5
 647  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 648  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 649  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7
 650  0000 ~                    pop hl
 651  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 652  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 653  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6
 654  0000                      ENDM
 655  0000
 656  0000              ; Copy cached screen corner of face vertex (HL)+ into p2buf (DE)+ with the
 657  0000              ; outline flag for edge bit EB taken from df_mask.  B = high vtx.
 658  0000                      MACRO FACEVTX EB
 659  0000 ~                    ld a,(hl)
 660  0000 ~                    inc hl
 661  0000 ~                    add a,7
 662  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 663  0000 ~                    ld a,(bc)
 664  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 665  0000 ~                    inc e
 666  0000 ~                    inc c
 667  0000 ~                    ld a,(bc)
 668  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 669  0000 ~                    inc e
 670  0000 ~                    ld a,(df_mask)
 671  0000 ~                    and EB
 672  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 673  0000 ~                    inc e
 674  0000 ~                    inc e
 675  0000                      ENDM

 680  0000              ; the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.

 682  0000                      MMU BOOT_SLOT e, PAGE_BOOT, BOOT_ADDR

 700  A057                      INCLUDE "levels.asm"            ; the current level's record
# file opened: levels.asm
   1+ A057              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A057              ; Z-POLICE - the current level's settings (resident, so any page can read
   3+ A057              ; them)
   4+ A057              ;
   5+ A057              ; level_cur holds the record of the level being played, loaded from its file
   6+ A057              ; ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL by load_level (level_load.asm).  LV_SIZE bytes:
   7+ A057              ;   +0  LV_NUM          level number
   8+ A057              ;   +1  LV_NAME         city name, 8 characters (ASCII, space padded)
   9+ A057              ;   +9  LV_ZOMBIES      number of zombies a wave (at most NZOMB)
  10+ A057              ;   +10 LV_WAVES        number of zombie waves (1..LV_MAX_WAVES)
  11+ A057              ;   +11 LV_FAST         number of fast zombies (of LV_ZOMBIES)
  12+ A057              ;   +12 LV_VIEW_R       draw distance in tiles, 2..VIEW_R (fewer: night or
  13+ A057              ;                       fog); load_level sets view_r / dot_r from it
  14+ A057              ;   +13 LV_WAVE_DATA    the special monsters of each wave, waves 1 to
  15+ A057              ;                       LV_MAX_WAVES (wave 1 is the level's start), LV_WAVE_REC
  16+ A057              ;                       bytes each:
  17+ A057              ;         +0  LV_SPECIAL_ID   LV_SPEC_SLOTS special types (SPEC_*;
  18+ A057              ;                             SPEC_NONE, 255: none in that place)
  19+ A057              ;         +5  LV_SPECIAL      how many of each (in the same places)
  20+ A057              ; The levels and their cities are made by gentables.py (ZPDATA/); a level
  21+ A057              ; file can be replaced by a hand-made one (or its text form, .TXL, edited).
  22+ A057              ;==============================================================================
  23+ A057
  24+ A057              LV_NUM          equ 0
  25+ A057              LV_NAME         equ 1
  26+ A057              LV_NAME_LEN     equ 8
  27+ A057              LV_ZOMBIES      equ LV_NAME+LV_NAME_LEN
  28+ A057              LV_WAVES        equ LV_ZOMBIES+1
  29+ A057              LV_FAST         equ LV_WAVES+1
  30+ A057              LV_VIEW_R       equ LV_FAST+1
  31+ A057              LV_WAVE_DATA    equ LV_VIEW_R+1
  32+ A057              LV_MAX_WAVES    equ 10              ; waves a level can have specials for
  33+ A057              LV_SPEC_SLOTS   equ 5               ; special types a wave
  34+ A057              LV_SPECIAL_ID   equ 0               ; (in a wave's data) the types,
  35+ A057              LV_SPECIAL      equ LV_SPEC_SLOTS   ;   then how many of each
  36+ A057              LV_WAVE_REC     equ 2*LV_SPEC_SLOTS
  37+ A057              LV_SIZE         equ LV_WAVE_DATA+LV_MAX_WAVES*LV_WAVE_REC   ; 113 bytes
  38+ A057                      ASSERT LV_SIZE == 113           ; (gentables.py writes it)
  39+ A057              ; Special monster types in the level files (specials.asm: spec_types)
  40+ A057              SPEC_GHOST      equ 0
  41+ A057              SPEC_BANSHEE    equ 1
  42+ A057              SPEC_GHOUL      equ 2
  43+ A057              SPEC_IDS        equ 3               ; (how many types)
  44+ A057              SPEC_NONE       equ 255
  45+ A057
  46+ A057              ; -> HL = the current level's record
  47+ A057              level_entry:
  48+ A057 21 5B A0             ld hl,level_cur
  49+ A05A C9                   ret
  50+ A05B
  51+ A05B 00 00 00...  level_cur:  ds LV_SIZE                  ; the level being played (load_level)
  52+ A0CC
# file closed: levels.asm

 102+ A146 CD 51 A1     .in:    call menu_line                  ; let any current blanking end

 104+ A14B CD 51 A1     .out:   call menu_line                  ; then wait for the next one
 105+ A14E 38 FB                jr c,.out
 106+ A150 C9                   ret
 107+ A151
 108+ A151              ; Carry clear if the raster is at line 192 or later (blanking).  The line is
 109+ A151              ; read as high byte ($1E), low byte ($1F), high byte again: if the high
 110+ A151              ; byte changed in between (line 255 -> 256) the pair is torn, so read again.
 111+ A151              menu_line:
 112+ A151 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 113+ A154 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
 114+ A156 ED 79                out (c),a
 115+ A158 04                   inc b
 116+ A159 ED 58                in e,(c)                        ; high byte
 117+ A15B 05                   dec b
 118+ A15C 3E 1F                ld a,$1F
 119+ A15E ED 79                out (c),a
 120+ A160 04                   inc b
 121+ A161 ED 50                in d,(c)                        ; low byte
 122+ A163 05                   dec b
 123+ A164 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
 124+ A166 ED 79                out (c),a
 125+ A168 04                   inc b
 126+ A169 ED 78                in a,(c)
 127+ A16B BB                   cp e
 128+ A16C 20 E3                jr nz,menu_line                 ; torn: again
 129+ A16E E6 01                and 1
 130+ A170 C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256 (carry clear)
 131+ A171 7A                   ld a,d
 132+ A172 FE C0                cp 192
 133+ A174 C9                   ret

 702  A375                      INCLUDE "sfx_data.asm"          ; the sound effects (sfx_tick plays them)
# file opened: sfx_data.asm
   1+ A375              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A375              ; Z-POLICE - sound effect data (resident: the main page, slot 5, always
   3+ A375              ; mapped, so the interrupt routine can read it whatever else is paged in)
   4+ A375              ;
   5+ A375              ; Played on AY 2 by sfx_tick (interrupts.asm); the game asks for one with
   6+ A375              ; ld a,SFX_n / ld (sfx_req),a (the numbers are in audio.asm).  A sound is a
   7+ A375              ; list of steps, one an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value
   8+ A375              ; pairs, ended by SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (over).
   9+ A375              ; The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is 109375/P Hz; a
  10+ A375              ; lower noise period is a brighter hiss.
  11+ A375              ;==============================================================================
  12+ A375
  13+ A375              ; One step of a zap: channel A at tone period p, channel B 2 periods flat
  14+ A375              ; (the two beat: a buzz), volumes v and v-2
  15+ A375                  MACRO SFX_ZAP p, v
  16+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_A, low (p), AY_TONE_A+1, high (p)
  17+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low ((p)+2), AY_TONE_B+1, high ((p)+2)
  18+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, v, AY_VOL_B, (v)-2, SFX_STEP
  19+ A375                  ENDM
  20+ A375
  21+ A375              ; One step of a woosh: channel A's noise at period n, volume v
  22+ A375                  MACRO SFX_WOOSH n, v
  23+ A375 ~                    db AY_NOISE, n, AY_VOL_A, v, SFX_STEP
  24+ A375                  ENDM
  25+ A375
  26+ A375              ; An explosion: a deep noise (channel A, darkening: period 16 up to 30) over
  27+ A375              ; a low rumble (channel B, BOOM_RUMBLE), both from volume peak (B 2 less)
  28+ A375              ; fading to nothing over len steps.  (A falling level is an exponential fade:
  29+ A375              ; the AY's levels are logarithmic.)
  30+ A375              BOOM_RUMBLE     equ 2735            ; 109375 / 2735 = 40 Hz
  31+ A375                  MACRO SFX_BOOM peak, len
  32+ A375 ~                    db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_BOOM       ; (channel C: the splats', left alone)
  33+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low BOOM_RUMBLE, AY_TONE_B+1, high BOOM_RUMBLE
  34+ A375 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL 0
  35+ A375 ~                    DUP len
  36+ A375 ~                    db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(len)
  37+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, ((peak)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  38+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_B, (((peak)-2)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  39+ A375 ~                    db SFX_STEP
  40+ A375 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
  41+ A375 ~                    EDUP
  42+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END
  43+ A375                  ENDM
  44+ A375
  45+ A375              ; One step of a splat: channel C (only: see sfx_tick) at tone period p,
  46+ A375              ; volume v
  47+ A375                  MACRO SFX_SPLAT_STEP p, v
  48+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_C, low (p), AY_TONE_C+1, high (p), AY_VOL_C, v, SFX_STEP
  49+ A375                  ENDM

 158+ A498              ; Explosions (rocket_blast, weapons.asm; on AY 3).  Each one's loudness in
 159+ A498              ; proportion to its blast's size, damage x reach (game units):
 160+ A498              ;   missile 15 x 256 = 3840, rocket 20 x 64 = 1280, autocannon 4 x 38 = 152,
 161+ A498              ;   proximity 3 x 25 = 75.
 162+ A498              ; Sound level is logarithmic (about 2 AY levels each doubling), so the peak
 163+ A498              ; is 15 + 2*log2(size / the missile's): 15, 12, 6, 4; and the bigger the

 177+ A6CA              ; The VTOL hitting a building (player.asm; on AY 3, as the explosions): a

  37+ A7F1 7D
  38+ A7F2 EC A7        l2_fill_astrt           DW l2_cls_byte
  39+ A7F4 00 C0        l2_fill_length          DB $00,$C0
  40+ A7F6 24 10 AD                             DB DMA_WR1_P1FIXED_MEMORY ,DMA_WR2_P2INC_MEMORY ,DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE

  42+ A7FB 82 CF B3 87                          DB DMA_STOP_AT_END, DMA_LOAD, DMA_FORCE_READY, DMA_ENABLE

  45+ A7FF
  46+ A7FF              ; DMA fill: HL = destination, BC = length (non-zero), A = the byte.  Any
  47+ A7FF              ; memory mapped in now (the Layer 2 sections in slot 0, the occlusion page,
  48+ A7FF              ; the ULA screen).  Resident (the main page, with this block), so the city,
  49+ A7FF              ; HUD and menu pages all use it.  It leaves the length's high byte set:
  50+ A7FF              ; fill_spans needs it 0 (clear_screen.spans), so the city page restores it
  51+ A7FF              ; after a fill of its own.
  52+ A7FF              dma_fill:

  54+ A802 22 F9 A7             ld (l2_fill_bstrt),hl

 964  AA3A ~                    call fps_tick                   ; HUD page is still at $E000
 965  AA3A                  ENDIF
 966  AA3A ED 91 57 0D          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES   ; the HUD sprites (humans, compass)
 967  AA3E CD A0 E2             call hud_sprites                ; (hud_sprites.asm), with the new frame
 968  AA41 C3 B4 A9             jp main_loop
 969  AA44
 970  AA44              ;==============================================================================
 971  AA44              ; Frames per second, shown on the ULA layer above Layer 2.
 972  AA44              ;
 973  AA44              ; Interrupts stay off (the span filler borrows SP), so time is taken from the
 974  AA44              ; raster: vtick reads the current video line and counts a new 50Hz video
 975  AA44              ; frame whenever the line number has gone backwards.  It must be called at
 976  AA44              ; least once per video frame (~560K T at 28MHz); the main loop and draw_cell
 977  AA44              ; do that.  Every 50 video frames (1 second) the number of frames rendered
 978  AA44              ; becomes the FPS figure.
 979  AA44              ;==============================================================================
 980  AA44                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
 981  AA44 ~            vtick:
 982  AA44 ~                    ld bc,$243B
 983  AA44 ~                    ld a,$1E
 984  AA44 ~                    out (c),a
 985  AA44 ~                    inc b
 986  AA44 ~                    in d,(c)                        ; line MSB
 987  AA44 ~                    dec b
 988  AA44 ~                    ld a,$1F
 989  AA44 ~                    out (c),a
 990  AA44 ~                    inc b
 991  AA44 ~                    in e,(c)                        ; line LSB
 992  AA44 ~                    dec b
 993  AA44 ~                    ld a,$1E
 994  AA44 ~                    out (c),a
 995  AA44 ~                    inc b
 996  AA44 ~                    in a,(c)
 997  AA44 ~                    cp d
 998  AA44 ~                    jr nz,vtick                     ; MSB changed mid-read: try again
 999  AA44 ~                    and 1
1000  AA44 ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = video line 0..311
1001  AA44 ~                    ld hl,(fps_line)
1002  AA44 ~                    ld (fps_line),de
1003  AA44 ~                    or a
1004  AA44 ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; previous - current
1005  AA44 ~                    ret c
1006  AA44 ~                    ret z
1007  AA44 ~                    ld hl,fps_vframes               ; line went backwards: new frame
1008  AA44 ~                    inc (hl)
1009  AA44 ~                    ret
1010  AA44 ~
1011  AA44 ~            ; Once per rendered frame, after the flip
1012  AA44 ~            fps_tick:
1013  AA44 ~                    call vtick
1014  AA44 ~                    ld hl,fps_count
1015  AA44 ~                    inc (hl)
1016  AA44 ~                    ld a,(fps_vframes)
1017  AA44 ~                    cp 50
1018  AA44 ~                    ret c
1019  AA44 ~                    sub 50
1020  AA44 ~                    ld (fps_vframes),a
1021  AA44 ~                    ld a,(fps_count)
1022  AA44 ~                    ld (fps_value),a
1023  AA44 ~                    xor a
1024  AA44 ~                    ld (fps_count),a
1025  AA44 ~                    jp fps_draw                     ; HUD page (paged in by main_loop)
1026  AA44                  ENDIF
1027  AA44
1028  AA44              ; A = NextReg number -> A = its value
1029  AA44              read_nextreg:
1030  AA44 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1031  AA47 ED 79                out (c),a
1032  AA49 04                   inc b
1033  AA4A ED 78                in a,(c)
1034  AA4C C9                   ret
1035  AA4D
1036  AA4D              ; Select the shadow Layer 2 buffer for drawing: remember the 8K page of its
1037  AA4D              ; first row.  Sections are then paged in on demand by seg_map / line_seg.
1038  AA4D              map_shadow:
1039  AA4D 3E 13                ld a,$13
1040  AA4F CD 44 AA             call read_nextreg
1041  AA52 87                   add a,a                         ; 16K bank -> 8K page
1042  AA53 32 7F B6             ld (seg_base),a
1043  AA56 C9                   ret
1044  AA57
1045  AA57              ; Show the shadow buffer and make the old active buffer the new shadow
1046  AA57              l2_flip:
1047  AA57 3E 12                ld a,$12
1048  AA59 CD 44 AA             call read_nextreg
1049  AA5C 5F                   ld e,a                          ; old active
1050  AA5D 3E 13                ld a,$13
1051  AA5F CD 44 AA             call read_nextreg
1052  AA62 ED 92 12             nextreg $12,a                   ; shadow -> active
1053  AA65 7B                   ld a,e
1054  AA66 ED 92 13             nextreg $13,a                   ; old active -> shadow
1055  AA69 C9                   ret
1056  AA6A
1057  AA6A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1058  AA6A              ; Layer 2 writes go through MMU slot 0 ($0000-$1FFF) only.  Each 8K page of
1059  AA6A              ; the buffer is a 32-row section, so row y is page seg_base + y/32 and its
1060  AA6A              ; pixels are at (y & 31)*256 + x.  Sections are paged in as drawing reaches
1061  AA6A              ; them.  Slots 4-5 keep the ULA screen.
1062  AA6A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1063  AA6A
1064  AA6A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1065  AA6A              ; Screen shake, when the VTOL hits a building (player.asm sets shake_t to
1066  AA6A              ; SHAKE_LEN).  Each rendered frame, as it is shown, the Layer 2 view is
1067  AA6A              ; offset by the next pair of shake_xy through the scroll registers, a pixel
1068  AA6A              ; or two each way, dying away; the last pair (0, 0) puts it back.  Only
1069  AA6A              ; Layer 2 moves: the HUD is on the ULA.  (X wraps at 256, Y at 192: -n is
1070  AA6A              ; 256-n and 192-n.  An edge row or column of the view shows the far side's
1071  AA6A              ; meanwhile.)
1072  AA6A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1073  AA6A              SHAKE_LEN       equ 6               ; rendered frames (about half a second)
1074  AA6A              shake_tick:
1075  AA6A 3A 9C AA             ld a,(shake_t)
1076  AA6D B7                   or a
1077  AA6E C8                   ret z
1078  AA6F 3D                   dec a
1079  AA70 32 9C AA             ld (shake_t),a
1080  AA73 87                   add a,a
1081  AA74 21 90 AA             ld hl,shake_xy
1082  AA77 ED 31                add hl,a
1083  AA79 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1084  AA7A ED 92 16             nextreg $16,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
1085  AA7D 23                   inc hl
1086  AA7E 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1087  AA7F ED 92 17             nextreg $17,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
1088  AA82 C9                   ret
1089  AA83
1090  AA83              ; Stop any shake: the view back in place
1091  AA83              shake_off:
1092  AA83 AF                   xor a
1093  AA84 32 9C AA             ld (shake_t),a
1094  AA87 ED 91 16 00          nextreg $16,0
1095  AA8B ED 91 17 00          nextreg $17,0
1096  AA8F C9                   ret
1097  AA90
1098  AA90              ; (x, y) pixels, used from the last pair back to the first
1099  AA90 00 00 01 00  shake_xy:   db 0,0, 1,0, 256-1,192-1, 1,1, 256-2,192-1, 2,1
1099  AA94 FF BF 01 01
1099  AA98 FE BF 02 01
1100  AA9C                      ASSERT $ - shake_xy == 2*SHAKE_LEN
1101  AA9C 00           shake_t:    db 0                        ; frames of shake left (0: none)
1102  AA9D 00           gfx_ok:     db 0                        ; 1: the figures' graphics are loaded
1103  AA9E
1104  AA9E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1105  AA9E              ; Wait until the raster is outside the display area (line >= 192)
1106  AA9E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1107  AA9E              wait_vblank:
1108  AA9E 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1109  AAA1 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
1110  AAA3 ED 79                out (c),a
1111  AAA5 04                   inc b
1112  AAA6 ED 78                in a,(c)
1113  AAA8 E6 01                and 1
1114  AAAA C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256
1115  AAAB 05                   dec b
1116  AAAC 3E 1F                ld a,$1F
1117  AAAE ED 79                out (c),a
1118  AAB0 04                   inc b
1119  AAB1 ED 78                in a,(c)
1120  AAB3 FE C0                cp 192
1121  AAB5 38 E7                jr c,wait_vblank
1122  AAB7 C9                   ret
1123  AAB8
1124  AAB8              ; HL -> map byte for the cell the camera is in
1125  AAB8              cam_cell_ptr:
1126  AAB8 3A 98 AF             ld a,(cam_z+2)
1127  AABB 6F                   ld l,a
1128  AABC 26 00                ld h,0
1129  AABE                      ROWOFS
1129  AABE 29          >        add hl,hl
1129  AABF 29          >        add hl,hl
1129  AAC0 29          >        add hl,hl
1129  AAC1 29          >        add hl,hl
1129  AAC2 29          >        add hl,hl
1129  AAC3 29          >        add hl,hl
1130  AAC4 3A 95 AF             ld a,(cam_x+2)
1131  AAC7 ED 31                add hl,a
1132  AAC9 11 00 70             ld de,city_map
1133  AACC 19                   add hl,de
1134  AACD C9                   ret
1135  AACE
1136  AACE              ; A = damage to the VTOL (a building crash, a ghost): its hit points
1137  AACE              ; (vtol_hp) fall by that, not below 0.  At 0 it is destroyed (vtol_dead): it
1138  AACE              ; spins down out of control (vtol_wreck, player.asm), then the game is over.
1139  AACE              vtol_damage:
1140  AACE B7                   or a
1141  AACF C8                   ret z
1142  AAD0 4F                   ld c,a
1143  AAD1 3A B0 AF             ld a,(vtol_hp)
1144  AAD4 91                   sub c
1145  AAD5 30 01                jr nc,.hp
1146  AAD7 AF                   xor a
1147  AAD8 32 B0 AF     .hp:    ld (vtol_hp),a
1148  AADB C0                   ret nz
1149  AADC 3E 01                ld a,1
1150  AADE 32 B1 AF             ld (vtol_dead),a
1151  AAE1 C9                   ret
1152  AAE2
1153  AAE2              ; HL = the height the VTOL rests at: MIN_Y when its whole footprint is over

1164  AAF1              ; Weapon type details, by WPN_*: its full load, reload frames a shot (0:
1165  AAF1              ; doesn't reload; the AMMO_INF weapons) and the slots it may be fitted in

1169  AAF7 FF 00 01                 db AMMO_INF, 0, WS_CENTRE                   ; WPN_LASER

1171  AAFD 0C 0F 1E                 db ROCKET_SHOTS, ROCKET_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS   ; WPN_ROCKETS

1177  AB0F C8 01 10                 db LINK_SHOTS, LINK_RELOAD, WS_LINK_R       ; WPN_LCHAIN_R
1178  AB12                      ASSERT LINK_SHOTS < AMMO_INF

1224  AB3E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1225  AB3E              ; Paused (main_loop: the pause control, K_PAUSE, BREAK or a Mega Drive pad's
1226  AB3E              ; START by default): PAUSED over the view, white on an opaque black ULA box,
1227  AB3E              ; and under it S: SAVE AND QUIT and X: QUIT, NO SAVE, until the pause control
1228  AB3E              ; is pressed again.  Nothing moves meanwhile and the screen keeps its last
1229  AB3E              ; frame.  S (fixed: only while paused) saves the game (save_game) and goes
1230  AB3E              ; back to the main menu; if it can't be saved, SAVE FAILED, and it stays
1231  AB3E              ; paused.  (Not in a wreck: nothing to save.)  X (fixed too) goes back to
1232  AB3E              ; the main menu without saving: the game is lost, and any save game is left
1233  AB3E              ; as it was.  Needs the input page in slot 7.
1234  AB3E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1235  AB3E              PAUSE_ROW       equ 7               ; ULA character row and column of the box
1236  AB3E              PAUSE_COL       equ 12
1237  AB3E              PAUSE_ROW2      equ 9               ; and of the save line
1238  AB3E              PAUSE_COL2      equ 7
1239  AB3E              PAUSE_ROW3      equ 10              ; and of the quit line
1240  AB3E              PAUSE_ATTR      equ 2<<3 | 7        ; paper 2 (opaque black), ink 7 (white)
1241  AB3E              VIEW_ATTR       equ %01000111       ; the viewport's own (ula_init): transparent
1242  AB3E              game_pause:

1244  AB41 11 0C 07             ld de,PAUSE_ROW<<8 | PAUSE_COL
1245  AB44 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1246  AB46 CD FC A0             call menu_print
1247  AB49 21 14 AC             ld hl,txt_pause_quit
1248  AB4C 11 07 0A             ld de,PAUSE_ROW3<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1249  AB4F 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1250  AB51 CD FC A0             call menu_print
1251  AB54 3A B1 AF             ld a,(vtol_dead)
1252  AB57 B7                   or a
1253  AB58 20 0B                jr nz,.w                        ; (a wreck: no saving)
1254  AB5A 21 DB AB             ld hl,txt_pause_save
1255  AB5D 11 07 09             ld de,PAUSE_ROW2<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1256  AB60 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1257  AB62 CD FC A0             call menu_print
1258  AB65 CD 46 A1     .w:     call menu_frame
1259  AB68 CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan

1261  AB6E B7                   or a
1262  AB6F 20 08                jr nz,.np
1263  AB71 21 02 01             ld hl,KB_S                      ; save and quit
1264  AB74 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
1265  AB77 20 30                jr nz,.save
1266  AB79 21 04 00     .np:    ld hl,KB_X                      ; quit, no save
1267  AB7C CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed

1270  AB83 CD CF E0             call key_pressed

1273  AB8B 11 0C 07             ld de,PAUSE_ROW<<8 | PAUSE_COL
1274  AB8E 0E 47                ld c,VIEW_ATTR

1307  AC27              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1308  AC27              ; Save games: ZPDATA/SAVEGAME.ZPS (beside the level files), one game.  Written
1309  AC27              ; by save and quit (game_pause: save_game), read by CONTINUE on the main menu
1310  AC27              ; (load_save, continue_game).  "ZPSV", SG_VERSION, then the fields in
1311  AC27              ; sg_fields, in order: the level and wave, the salvage, the VTOL's integrity
1312  AC27              ; (vtol_hp), its weapon slots (type and ammo each) and the selected one, the
1313  AC27              ; store (wpn_stock, wpn_unlocked), the booster (fitted, fuel), and the
1314  AC27              ; vision modes (vision_owned), and the vertical and lateral thrusters
1315  AC27              ; (vthrust_fitted, lthrust_fitted).  Files of an older version (1: before
1316  AC27              ; the vision modes, 2: before the vertical thrusters, 3: before the lateral
1317  AC27              ; ones, 4: before the linked chain guns, a longer store) are refused, as any
1318  AC27              ; other version.
1319  AC27              ; Continued, the level starts afresh at the saved wave: its zombies, the
1320  AC27              ; humans (and this level's rescues so far) and the base are new.
1321  AC27              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1322  AC27              SG_VERSION      equ 5
1323  AC27              sg_fields:      ; address, bytes
1324  AC27 AD AF                dw level
1325  AC29 01                   db 1
1326  AC2A B6 AF                dw wave_number
1327  AC2C 01                   db 1
1328  AC2D B8 AF                dw salvage_points
1329  AC2F 02                   db 2
1330  AC30 B0 AF                dw vtol_hp
1331  AC32 01                   db 1
1332  AC33 A0 AF                dw wpn_slots
1333  AC35 0A                   db WPN_SLOTS*2
1334  AC36 AA AF                dw wpn_sel
1335  AC38 01                   db 1
1336  AC39 21 B0                dw wpn_stock
1337  AC3B 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
1338  AC3C 2C B0                dw wpn_unlocked
1339  AC3E 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
1340  AC3F 3C B0                dw boost_fitted                 ; (and boost_fuel, after it)
1341  AC41 02                   db 2
1342  AC42 37 B0                dw vision_owned
1343  AC44 01                   db 1
1344  AC45 38 B0                dw vthrust_fitted
1345  AC47 01                   db 1
1346  AC48 39 B0                dw lthrust_fitted
1347  AC4A 01                   db 1
1348  AC4B 00 00                dw 0                            ; (the end)
1349  AC4D                      ASSERT boost_fuel == boost_fitted+1
1350  AC4D              SG_SIZE         equ 5+1+1+2+1+WPN_SLOTS*2+1+2*(WPN_LAST+1)+2+1+1+1
1351  AC4D
1352  AC4D              ; Copy the fields: A = 0 the game's into sg_buf, 1 sg_buf's into the game
1353  AC4D              sg_copy:
1354  AC4D 32 08 AD             ld (sg_dir),a
1355  AC50 DD 21 27 AC          ld ix,sg_fields
1356  AC54 11 0F AD             ld de,sg_buf+5
1357  AC57 DD 6E 00     .lp:    ld l,(ix+0)
1358  AC5A DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1359  AC5D 7C                   ld a,h
1360  AC5E B5                   or l
1361  AC5F C8                   ret z
1362  AC60 DD 4E 02             ld c,(ix+2)
1363  AC63 06 00                ld b,0
1364  AC65 3A 08 AD             ld a,(sg_dir)
1365  AC68 B7                   or a
1366  AC69 28 06                jr z,.out
1367  AC6B EB                   ex de,hl                        ; into the game: HL = sg_buf
1368  AC6C ED B0                ldir

1639  AEA3              ; A = angle -> HL = sin (S7.8).  Pages the sine table into slot 0 (PAGE_SIN):

1652  AEAF              ; Rotate the building edge vectors (s,0,0) and (0,0,s) into camera space.
1653  AEAF              ; HL = s, IX -> 16 bytes: VX(X,Y,Z) VZ(X,Y,Z) corner offset (X,Z1)

1713  AF4E              ;==============================================================================
1714  AF4E              ; Fixed point maths
1715  AF4E              ;==============================================================================
1716  AF4E
1717  AF4E              ; HL = -HL
1718  AF4E              neg_hl:
1719  AF4E AF                   xor a
1720  AF4F 95                   sub l
1721  AF50 6F                   ld l,a
1722  AF51 9F                   sbc a,a
1723  AF52 94                   sub h
1724  AF53 67                   ld h,a
1725  AF54 C9                   ret
1726  AF55
1727  AF55              ; HL = |HL|
1728  AF55              abs_hl:
1729  AF55 CB 7C                bit 7,h
1730  AF57 C8                   ret z
1731  AF58 18 F4                jr neg_hl
1732  AF5A
1733  AF5A              ; fmul: HL = HL * DE >> 8
1734  AF5A              ;   HL = signed 16-bit integer, DE = S7.8 factor in -1.0..+1.0
1735  AF5A              ;   Sign/magnitude using two 8x8 MUL D,E.  Preserves IX, IY.
1736  AF5A              fmul:
1737  AF5A 7C                   ld a,h
1738  AF5B AA                   xor d
1739  AF5C F5                   push af                         ; result sign in bit 7
1740  AF5D CB 7C                bit 7,h
1741  AF5F 28 06                jr z,.ap
1742  AF61 AF                   xor a
1743  AF62 95                   sub l
1744  AF63 6F                   ld l,a
1745  AF64 9F                   sbc a,a
1746  AF65 94                   sub h
1747  AF66 67                   ld h,a
1748  AF67 CB 7A        .ap:    bit 7,d
1749  AF69 28 06                jr z,.bp
1750  AF6B AF                   xor a
1751  AF6C 93                   sub e
1752  AF6D 5F                   ld e,a
1753  AF6E 9F                   sbc a,a
1754  AF6F 92                   sub d
1755  AF70 57                   ld d,a
1756  AF71 7A           .bp:    ld a,d
1757  AF72 B7                   or a
1758  AF73 20 10                jr nz,.one                      ; |factor| == 1.0
1759  AF75 7B                   ld a,e
1760  AF76 55                   ld d,l
1761  AF77 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; lo * f
1762  AF79 4A                   ld c,d
1763  AF7A 54                   ld d,h
1764  AF7B 5F                   ld e,a
1765  AF7C ED 30                mul d,e                         ; hi * f
1766  AF7E 7B                   ld a,e
1767  AF7F 81                   add a,c
1768  AF80 6F                   ld l,a
1769  AF81 7A                   ld a,d
1770  AF82 CE 00                adc a,0
1771  AF84 67                   ld h,a
1772  AF85 F1           .one:   pop af
1773  AF86 F0                   ret p
1774  AF87 AF                   xor a
1775  AF88 95                   sub l
1776  AF89 6F                   ld l,a
1777  AF8A 9F                   sbc a,a
1778  AF8B 94                   sub h
1779  AF8C 67                   ld h,a
1780  AF8D C9                   ret
1781  AF8E
1782  AF8E              ; HL = 0.5 * HL (signed): the top/bottom frustum slope, VIEW_CY/128
1783  AF8E              zhalf:
1784  AF8E CB 2C                sra h
1785  AF90 CB 1D                rr l
1786  AF92 C9                   ret

1798  AF9D 00           pitch_frac: ds 1                        ; fraction below pitch (keep together:
1799  AF9E 00           pitch:      ds 1                        ; pitch_frac/pitch is one signed 8.8
1800  AF9F                                                      ; word; drawing uses pitch only)
1801  AF9F 00           speed:      ds 1

1803  AFA0              ; is wpn_slots + n*2.
1804  AFA0 00 00 00...  wpn_slots:  ds WPN_SLOTS*2

1806  AFAB 00           wflash_slot: ds 1                       ; empty slot requested: which, and
1807  AFAC 00           wflash_t:   ds 1                        ; frames of yellow/blue flash left
1808  AFAD 01           level:      db START_LEVEL              ; current level (newGame: START_LEVEL)
1809  AFAE 08           view_r:     db VIEW_R                   ; draw distance, tiles (load_level)
1810  AFAF 07           dot_r:      db VIEW_R-1                 ; street dots' radius (load_level)
1811  AFB0 32           vtol_hp:    db VTOL_HP                  ; the VTOL's hit points (newGame)
1812  AFB1 00           vtol_dead:  db 0                        ; 1: destroyed (hit points 0)

 173+ E883              ; IX = (HL << 16) / DE   with HL < DE (unsigned) -> 0.16 fraction
 174+ E883              ; Restoring division, unrolled: each quotient bit goes in inverted, as the

 179+ E883 ~                    jr c,$+9                        ; (17-bit remainder: it fits)
 180+ E883 ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; (carry clear)

 186+ E883 ~                    or a                            ; bit 1
 187+ E883 ~                    q                               ; (all the jumps land here)

 193+ E8FC B7          >        or a                            ; bit 1

 202+ E90A C9                   ret
 203+ E90B
 204+ E90B              ; E = A / C, A = A mod C  (8-bit unsigned, C 1..127).  By reciprocal:
 205+ E90B              ; q = (A * R) >> 16, R = rcp8[C] = ceil(65536 / C), exact for every A
 206+ E90B              ; (gentables.py checks it); then the remainder A - q C.  Keeps C, D, H, L
 207+ E90B              ; (walk_edge's); B is lost.
 208+ E90B              div8:
 209+ E90B E5                   push hl
 210+ E90C D5                   push de
 211+ E90D 5F                   ld e,a                          ; A (the dividend)
 212+ E90E 79                   ld a,c
 213+ E90F 3D                   dec a
 214+ E910 28 1F                jr z,.one                       ; C = 1

 216+ E913 26 E7                ld h,high rcp8
 217+ E915 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; R low
 218+ E916 CB FD                set 7,l
 219+ E918 66                   ld h,(hl)                       ; R high
 220+ E919 6B                   ld l,e                          ; (A kept)
 221+ E91A ED 30                mul d,e                         ; A * R low
 222+ E91C 42                   ld b,d
 223+ E91D 54                   ld d,h
 224+ E91E 5D                   ld e,l
 225+ E91F ED 30                mul d,e                         ; A * R high
 226+ E921 78                   ld a,b
 227+ E922 83                   add a,e
 228+ E923 7A                   ld a,d
 229+ E924 CE 00                adc a,0                         ; q = (A Rh + (A Rl >> 8)) >> 8
 230+ E926 47                   ld b,a
 231+ E927 57                   ld d,a
 232+ E928 59                   ld e,c
 233+ E929 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; q C (< 256)
 234+ E92B 7D                   ld a,l
 235+ E92C 93                   sub e                           ; the remainder
 236+ E92D D1                   pop de
 237+ E92E E1                   pop hl
 238+ E92F 58                   ld e,b                          ; E = q
 239+ E930 C9                   ret
 240+ E931 43           .one:   ld b,e                          ; over 1: q = A, remainder 0
 241+ E932 AF                   xor a
 242+ E933 D1                   pop de
 243+ E934 E1                   pop hl
 244+ E935 58                   ld e,b
 245+ E936 C9                   ret
 246+ E937                      ASSERT low rcp8 == 0 && VIEW_H <= 128   ; (C, an edge's rows, < 128)
 247+ E937
 248+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 249+ E937              ; Perspective projection
 250+ E937              ;   in : HL -> X,Y,Z (camera space, inside the view frustum, Z > 0)
 251+ E937              ;   out: A = screen x (0..255), C = screen y (0..VIEW_H-1)
 252+ E937              ;   sx = 128 + 128*X/Z,  sy = 64 - 128*Y/Z   (90 x 53 degree field of view)
 253+ E937              ;   Z is normalised to 9 bits (256..511) with a barrel shift (count from a
 254+ E937              ;   log2 table) that is also applied to X and Y, which are then multiplied
 255+ E937              ;   by a 16-bit reciprocal from rtab.  |X| <= Z keeps Xn within 9 bits.
 256+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 257+ E937              project:

 259+ E938 23                   inc hl
 260+ E939 46                   ld b,(hl)
 261+ E93A 23                   inc hl                          ; BC = X

 263+ E93C 23                   inc hl
 264+ E93D 56                   ld d,(hl)
 265+ E93E 23                   inc hl                          ; DE = Y

 296+ E966              ; HL = Y -> C = screen y, A = screen x of the last project.  Uses the Z
 297+ E966              ; patched into scale_comp by the last project, so on its own it projects a
 298+ E966              ; point straight above or below that one when pitch is 0 (same X and Z).

 322+ E988              ; HL = Z (camera space): normalise it and patch its shift and reciprocal
 323+ E988              ; into scale_comp, which then gives A = |component| * 128 / Z
 324+ E988              zpatch:

 334+ E998 16 E6                ld d,high lgtab

 338+ E99D ED 2A                bsrl de,b

 370+ E9D4                  IFDEF CLIP_2D

 372+ E9D4              ; 2D clip of the current face (df_ptr, df_mask), no corner behind the near
 373+ E9D4              ; plane.  Carry set: a corner is outside the guard band (nothing drawn, clip

 617+ EB70              ; clip_isect for a 2D plane: the point where the edge S-E crosses it, out
 618+ EB70              ; at IY (IY and clip_on advanced).  Worked out from the edge's inside end,
 619+ EB70              ; so an edge two faces share is cut at the same point whichever way it
 620+ EB70              ; runs: t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|), the other coordinate o_in + t (o_out -
