 658+ EBB2 E1                   pop hl                          ; o_out - o_in
 659+ EBB3 DD E5                push ix
 660+ EBB5 D1                   pop de
 661+ EBB6 CD 50 E8             call mul_frac
 662+ EBB9 C1                   pop bc
 663+ EBBA 09           .same:  add hl,bc                       ; o_in + t (o_out - o_in)
 664+ EBBB 3A DC E0             ld a,(c2_off)
 665+ EBBE B7                   or a
 666+ EBBF 20 12                jr nz,.y
 667+ EBC1 FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l                     ; an x plane: y worked out
 668+ EBC4 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
 669+ EBC7 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 670+ EBCA FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 671+ EBCD FD 36 01 00          ld (iy+1),0
 672+ EBD1 18 10                jr .f
 673+ EBD3 FD 75 00     .y:     ld (iy+0),l                     ; a y plane: x worked out
 674+ EBD6 FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
 675+ EBD9 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 676+ EBDC FD 77 02             ld (iy+2),a
 677+ EBDF FD 36 03 00          ld (iy+3),0
 678+ EBE3 C3 50 EE     .f:     jp clip_isect.nz                ; its edge flag, IY and clip_on on
 679+ EBE6                  ENDIF
 680+ EBE6
 681+ EBE6              ; HL = signed component -> A = round(|HL| * 128 / Z)
 682+ EBE6              ; The shift and reciprocal for this Z are patched in by zpatch: the shift
 683+ EBE6              ; as a barrel shift whose count and direction (its opcode, BSRL or BSLA)
 684+ EBE6              ; are both patched, so it runs straight through (a right shift by 0 for a Z
 685+ EBE6              ; already 256..511 leaves it as it is).
 686+ EBE6              scale_comp:
 687+ EBE6 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 688+ EBE8 28 06                jr z,.ap
 689+ EBEA AF                   xor a
 690+ EBEB 95                   sub l
 691+ EBEC 6F                   ld l,a
 692+ EBED 9F                   sbc a,a
 693+ EBEE 94                   sub h
 694+ EBEF 67                   ld h,a
 695+ EBF0 EB           .ap:    ex de,hl
 696+ EBF1 06 00        .sh:    ld b,0                          ; (zpatch: the count)
 697+ EBF3 ED 2A        .op:    bsrl de,b                       ; (zpatch: bsrl, or bsla)
 698+ EBF5 EB                   ex de,hl
 699+ EBF6                      ASSERT {b scale_comp.op} == $ED && {b scale_comp.op+1} == OP_BSRL
 700+ EBF6 7C           .sd:    ld a,h
 701+ EBF7 FE 02                cp 2
 702+ EBF9 30 27                jr nc,.big
 703+ EBFB 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bit 8 of Xn
 704+ EBFC 55                   ld d,l
 705+ EBFD 1E 00        .rl:    ld e,0
 706+ EBFF ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 707+ EC01 4A                   ld c,d
 708+ EC02 55                   ld d,l
 709+ EC03 1E 00        .rh:    ld e,0
 710+ EC05 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh
 711+ EC07 79                   ld a,c
 712+ EC08 83                   add a,e
 713+ EC09 6F                   ld l,a
 714+ EC0A 7A                   ld a,d
 715+ EC0B CE 00                adc a,0
 716+ EC0D 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8
 717+ EC0E 0E 00                ld c,0
 718+ EC10 05                   dec b
 719+ EC11 20 06                jr nz,.nh
 720+ EC13 11 00 00     .r16:   ld de,0
 721+ EC16 19                   add hl,de                       ; + (256*R) >> 8
 722+ EC17 CB 11                rl c
 723+ EC19 24           .nh:    inc h                           ; + rounding (0.5 after >>9)
 724+ EC1A 20 01                jr nz,.nr
 725+ EC1C 0C                   inc c
 726+ EC1D 79           .nr:    ld a,c
 727+ EC1E 1F                   rra
 728+ EC1F 7C                   ld a,h
 729+ EC20 1F                   rra                             ; A = (C:H) >> 1  = P >> 9
 730+ EC21 C9                   ret
 731+ EC22 21 FF 01     .big:   ld hl,511                       ; clamp (rounding at frustum edge)
 732+ EC25 18 D4                jr .ok
 733+ EC27
 734+ EC27              ;==============================================================================
 735+ EC27              ; Outcode: HL -> vertex (X,Y,Z) -> A = bits
 736+ EC27              ;   1 near (Z<NEAR)  2 left (X<-Z)  4 right (X>Z)
 737+ EC27              ;   8 top (Y>0.5Z)   16 bottom (Y<-0.5Z)
 738+ EC27              ;==============================================================================
 739+ EC27              calc_oc:
 740+ EC27 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 741+ EC28 23                   inc hl
 742+ EC29 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE = X
 743+ EC2A 23                   inc hl
 744+ EC2B 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 745+ EC2C 23                   inc hl
 746+ EC2D 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; BC = Y
 747+ EC2E 23                   inc hl
 748+ EC2F 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 749+ EC30 23                   inc hl
 750+ EC31 66                   ld h,(hl)
 751+ EC32 6F                   ld l,a                          ; HL = Z
 752+ EC33 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 753+ EC35 20 0D                jr nz,.nr
 754+ EC37 7C                   ld a,h
 755+ EC38 B7                   or a
 756+ EC39 3E 00                ld a,0
 757+ EC3B 20 09                jr nz,.n1
 758+ EC3D 7D                   ld a,l
 759+ EC3E FE 10                cp NEAR
 760+ EC40 3E 00                ld a,0
 761+ EC42 30 02                jr nc,.n1
 762+ EC44 3E 01        .nr:    ld a,1
 763+ EC46 E5           .n1:    push hl
 764+ EC47 19                   add hl,de                       ; Z+X
 765+ EC48 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 766+ EC4A 28 02                jr z,.n2
 767+ EC4C F6 02                or 2
 768+ EC4E E1           .n2:    pop hl
 769+ EC4F E5                   push hl
 770+ EC50 B7                   or a
 771+ EC51 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; Z-X
 772+ EC53 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 773+ EC55 28 02                jr z,.n3
 774+ EC57 F6 04                or 4
 775+ EC59 E1           .n3:    pop hl
 776+ EC5A CB 2C                sra h
 777+ EC5C CB 1D                rr l                            ; 0.5Z
 778+ EC5E E5                   push hl
 779+ EC5F B7                   or a
 780+ EC60 ED 42                sbc hl,bc                       ; 0.5Z-Y
 781+ EC62 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 782+ EC64 28 02                jr z,.n4
 783+ EC66 F6 08                or 8
 784+ EC68 E1           .n4:    pop hl
 785+ EC69 09                   add hl,bc                       ; 0.5Z+Y
 786+ EC6A CB 7C                bit 7,h
 787+ EC6C C8                   ret z
 788+ EC6D F6 10                or 16
 789+ EC6F C9                   ret
 790+ EC70
 791+ EC70                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 792+ EC70              ; plane_dist for a 2D plane (clip2d): IX -> 2D vertex -> HL = its distance
 793+ EC70              ; inside c2_off / c2_hi (>= 0: inside)
 794+ EC70              c2_dist:
 795+ EC70 3A DC E0             ld a,(c2_off)
 796+ EC73 DD E5                push ix
 797+ EC75 E1                   pop hl
 798+ EC76 ED 31                add hl,a
 799+ EC78 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 800+ EC79 23                   inc hl
 801+ EC7A 66                   ld h,(hl)
 802+ EC7B 6F                   ld l,a
 803+ EC7C 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 804+ EC7F B7                   or a
 805+ EC80 C8                   ret z                           ; v >= 0: v
 806+ EC81 EB                   ex de,hl
 807+ EC82 6F                   ld l,a
 808+ EC83 26 00                ld h,0
 809+ EC85 B7                   or a
 810+ EC86 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; v <= bound: bound - v
 811+ EC88 C9                   ret
 812+ EC89                  ENDIF
 813+ EC89
 814+ EC89              ; Signed distance of vertex IX to clip plane (clip_plane bit). >= 0 is inside.
 815+ EC89              plane_dist:
 816+ EC89                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 817+ EC89 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 818+ EC8C 17                   rla
 819+ EC8D 38 E1                jr c,c2_dist                    ; (bit 7: a 2D plane)
 820+ EC8F                  ENDIF
 821+ EC8F DD 6E 04             ld l,(ix+4)
 822+ EC92 DD 66 05             ld h,(ix+5)
 823+ EC95 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 824+ EC98 FE 01                cp 1
 825+ EC9A 20 05                jr nz,.p2
 826+ EC9C 11 F0 FF             ld de,-NEAR
 827+ EC9F 19                   add hl,de
 828+ ECA0 C9                   ret
 829+ ECA1 DD 5E 00     .p2:    ld e,(ix+0)
 830+ ECA4 DD 56 01             ld d,(ix+1)
 831+ ECA7 FE 02                cp 2
 832+ ECA9 20 02                jr nz,.p3
 833+ ECAB 19                   add hl,de
 834+ ECAC C9                   ret
 835+ ECAD FE 04        .p3:    cp 4
 836+ ECAF 20 04                jr nz,.p4
 837+ ECB1 B7                   or a
 838+ ECB2 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 839+ ECB4 C9                   ret
 840+ ECB5 F5           .p4:    push af
 841+ ECB6 CD 8E AF             call zhalf
 842+ ECB9 F1                   pop af
 843+ ECBA DD 5E 02             ld e,(ix+2)
 844+ ECBD DD 56 03             ld d,(ix+3)
 845+ ECC0 FE 08                cp 8
 846+ ECC2 20 04                jr nz,.p5
 847+ ECC4 B7                   or a
 848+ ECC5 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 849+ ECC7 C9                   ret
 850+ ECC8 19           .p5:    add hl,de
 851+ ECC9 C9                   ret
 852+ ECCA
 853+ ECCA              ;==============================================================================
 854+ ECCA              ; Sutherland-Hodgman clip of clip_src (clip_n verts) against clip_plane into
 855+ ECCA              ; clip_dst.  Vertex = X,Y,Z,flag,corner (8 bytes).  flag=1 means the edge from
 856+ ECCA              ; this vertex to the next is a real building edge (gets outlined); edges
 857+ ECCA              ; created along a clip plane get flag=0 so the screen border isn't outlined.
 858+ ECCA              ; corner = vtx offset of an unclipped building corner that is on screen, so
 859+ ECCA              ; its cached projection can be reused; $80 + plane bit for a vertex the
 860+ ECCA              ; clipper put on that plane; $FF for any other vertex.
 861+ ECCA              ;==============================================================================
 862+ ECCA              clip_poly:
 863+ ECCA 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 864+ ECCD 3D                   dec a
 865+ ECCE 87                   add a,a
 866+ ECCF 87                   add a,a
 867+ ECD0 87                   add a,a
 868+ ECD1 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)
 869+ ECD4 ED 31                add hl,a
 870+ ECD6 22 CE E0             ld (clip_s),hl
 871+ ECD9 E5                   push hl
 872+ ECDA DD E1                pop ix
 873+ ECDC CD 89 EC             call plane_dist
 874+ ECDF 22 D2 E0             ld (clip_ds),hl
 875+ ECE2 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)
 876+ ECE5 22 D0 E0             ld (clip_e),hl
 877+ ECE8 FD 2A CC E0          ld iy,(clip_dst)
 878+ ECEC AF                   xor a
 879+ ECED 32 C7 E0             ld (clip_on),a
 880+ ECF0 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 881+ ECF3 32 C8 E0             ld (clip_cnt),a
 882+ ECF6 DD 2A D0 E0  .loop:  ld ix,(clip_e)
 883+ ECFA CD 89 EC             call plane_dist
 884+ ECFD 22 D4 E0             ld (clip_de),hl
 885+ ED00 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 886+ ED02 20 33                jr nz,.eout
 887+ ED04 3A D3 E0             ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 888+ ED07 CB 7F                bit 7,a
 889+ ED09 28 0D                jr z,.ein
 890+ ED0B                      ; S out, E in: intersection carries S's edge flag
 891+ ED0B DD 2A CE E0          ld ix,(clip_s)
 892+ ED0F DD 7E 06             ld a,(ix+6)
 893+ ED12 32 D6 E0             ld (clip_if),a
 894+ ED15 CD 73 ED             call clip_isect
 895+ ED18 2A D0 E0     .ein:   ld hl,(clip_e)                  ; whole vertex, with its corner byte
 896+ ED1B FD E5                push iy                         ; (LDI: 16 T a byte)
 897+ ED1D D1                   pop de
 898+ ED1E                      REPT 8
 899+ ED1E ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED20 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED22 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED24 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED26 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED28 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED2A ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED2C ED A0       >        ldi
 900+ ED2E                      ENDR
 901+ ED2E D5                   push de
 902+ ED2F FD E1                pop iy
 903+ ED31 21 C7 E0             ld hl,clip_on
 904+ ED34 34                   inc (hl)
 905+ ED35 18 0E                jr .next
 906+ ED37 3A D3 E0     .eout:  ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 907+ ED3A CB 7F                bit 7,a
 908+ ED3C 20 07                jr nz,.next
 909+ ED3E                      ; S in, E out: intersection starts a clip-plane edge
 910+ ED3E AF                   xor a
 911+ ED3F 32 D6 E0             ld (clip_if),a
 912+ ED42 CD 73 ED             call clip_isect
 913+ ED45 2A D0 E0     .next:  ld hl,(clip_e)
 914+ ED48 22 CE E0             ld (clip_s),hl
 915+ ED4B 11 08 00             ld de,8
 916+ ED4E 19                   add hl,de
 917+ ED4F 22 D0 E0             ld (clip_e),hl
 918+ ED52 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 919+ ED55 22 D2 E0             ld (clip_ds),hl
 920+ ED58 21 C8 E0             ld hl,clip_cnt
 921+ ED5B 35                   dec (hl)
 922+ ED5C 20 98                jr nz,.loop
 923+ ED5E 3A C7 E0             ld a,(clip_on)
 924+ ED61 32 C6 E0             ld (clip_n),a
 925+ ED64 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)                ; the output is the next pass's input
 926+ ED67 ED 5B CC E0          ld de,(clip_dst)
 927+ ED6B ED 53 CA E0          ld (clip_src),de
 928+ ED6F 22 CC E0             ld (clip_dst),hl
 929+ ED72 C9                   ret
 930+ ED73
 931+ ED73              ; Output S + t*(E-S) at IY, t = dS/(dS-dE)
 932+ ED73              clip_isect:
 933+ ED73                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 934+ ED73 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 935+ ED76 17                   rla
 936+ ED77 DA 70 EB             jp c,c2_isect                   ; (bit 7: a 2D plane)
 937+ ED7A                  ENDIF
 938+ ED7A                  IFDEF LEVEL_FAST_PATH
 939+ ED7A                      ; Level flight: a vertical building edge (S and E share X and Z)
 940+ ED7A                      ; meets the top or bottom plane at (X, +-0.5Z, Z) - no divide or
 941+ ED7A                      ; interpolation.  At pitch 0 vertical edges can't cross the near or
 942+ ED7A                      ; side planes, so this covers every plane they do cross.
 943+ ED7A 3A 9E AF             ld a,(pitch)
 944+ ED7D B7                   or a
 945+ ED7E 20 49                jr nz,.gen
 946+ ED80 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 947+ ED83 FE 08                cp 8
 948+ ED85 38 42                jr c,.gen                       ; not top or bottom
 949+ ED87 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
 950+ ED8A ED 5B D0 E0          ld de,(clip_e)
 951+ ED8E 1A                   ld a,(de)
 952+ ED8F BE                   cp (hl)
 953+ ED90 20 37                jr nz,.gen
 954+ ED92 23                   inc hl
 955+ ED93 13                   inc de
 956+ ED94 1A                   ld a,(de)
 957+ ED95 BE                   cp (hl)
 958+ ED96 20 31                jr nz,.gen                      ; X differs
 959+ ED98 23                   inc hl
 960+ ED99 23                   inc hl
 961+ ED9A 23                   inc hl
 962+ ED9B 13                   inc de
 963+ ED9C 13                   inc de
 964+ ED9D 13                   inc de
 965+ ED9E 1A                   ld a,(de)
 966+ ED9F BE                   cp (hl)
 967+ EDA0 20 27                jr nz,.gen
 968+ EDA2 23                   inc hl
 969+ EDA3 13                   inc de
 970+ EDA4 1A                   ld a,(de)
 971+ EDA5 BE                   cp (hl)
 972+ EDA6 20 21                jr nz,.gen                      ; Z differs
 973+ EDA8 DD 2A CE E0          ld ix,(clip_s)
 974+ EDAC DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+0)                     ; X and Z from S (= E)
 975+ EDAF FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 976+ EDB2 DD 7E 01             ld a,(ix+1)
 977+ EDB5 FD 77 01             ld (iy+1),a
 978+ EDB8 DD 6E 04             ld l,(ix+4)
 979+ EDBB DD 66 05             ld h,(ix+5)
 980+ EDBE FD 75 04             ld (iy+4),l
 981+ EDC1 FD 74 05             ld (iy+5),h
 982+ EDC4 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 983+ EDC7 18 6D                jr .ty                          ; Y = +-0.5Z
 984+ EDC9              .gen:
 985+ EDC9                  ENDIF
 986+ EDC9 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 987+ EDCC CD 55 AF             call abs_hl
 988+ EDCF 22 D7 E0             ld (ci_a),hl
 989+ EDD2 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 990+ EDD5 CD 55 AF             call abs_hl

 992+ EDDC 19                   add hl,de
 993+ EDDD EB                   ex de,hl                        ; DE = |dS|+|dE|, HL = |dS|
 994+ EDDE E5                   push hl
 995+ EDDF B7                   or a
 996+ EDE0 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 997+ EDE2 E1                   pop hl
 998+ EDE3 38 06                jr c,.dv
 999+ EDE5 DD 21 FF FF          ld ix,$FFFF
1000+ EDE9 18 03                jr .t
1001+ EDEB CD 83 E8     .dv:    call div_frac
1002+ EDEE DD 22 D9 E0  .t:     ld (ci_t),ix
1003+ EDF2 AF                   xor a
1004+ EDF3 CD 68 EE             call lerp_c
1005+ EDF6 FD 75 00             ld (iy+0),l
1006+ EDF9 FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
1007+ EDFC 3E 02                ld a,2
1008+ EDFE CD 68 EE             call lerp_c
1009+ EE01 FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l
1010+ EE04 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
1011+ EE07 3E 04                ld a,4
1012+ EE09 CD 68 EE             call lerp_c
1013+ EE0C FD 75 04             ld (iy+4),l
1014+ EE0F FD 74 05             ld (iy+5),h
1015+ EE12                      ; snap the point exactly onto the plane so rounding can't leave a
1016+ EE12                      ; gap between the polygon and the screen edge
1017+ EE12 FD 6E 04             ld l,(iy+4)
1018+ EE15 FD 66 05             ld h,(iy+5)                     ; Z
1019+ EE18 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
1020+ EE1B FE 01                cp 1
1021+ EE1D 20 0A                jr nz,.s2
1022+ EE1F FD 36 04 10          ld (iy+4),NEAR                  ; near:   Z = NEAR
1023+ EE23 FD 36 05 00          ld (iy+5),0
1024+ EE27 18 27                jr .nz
1025+ EE29 FE 02        .s2:    cp 2
1026+ EE2B 20 05                jr nz,.s4
1027+ EE2D CD 4E AF             call neg_hl                     ; left:   X = -Z

1029+ EE32 FE 04        .s4:    cp 4
1030+ EE34 28 14                jr z,.sx                        ; right:  X = Z
1031+ EE36 F5           .ty:    push af
1032+ EE37 CD 8E AF             call zhalf
1033+ EE3A F1                   pop af
1034+ EE3B FE 08                cp 8

1036+ EE3F CD 4E AF             call neg_hl                     ; bottom: Y = -0.5Z
1037+ EE42 FD 75 02     .sy:    ld (iy+2),l
1038+ EE45 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
1039+ EE48 18 06                jr .nz
1040+ EE4A FD 75 00     .sx:    ld (iy+0),l
1041+ EE4D FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
1042+ EE50 3A D6 E0     .nz:    ld a,(clip_if)
1043+ EE53 FD 77 06             ld (iy+6),a
1044+ EE56 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)               ; new vertex: no cached projection,
1045+ EE59 F6 80                or $80                          ; but remember the plane it is on
1046+ EE5B FD 77 07             ld (iy+7),a
1047+ EE5E 01 08 00             ld bc,8
1048+ EE61 FD 09                add iy,bc
1049+ EE63 21 C7 E0             ld hl,clip_on
1050+ EE66 34                   inc (hl)
1051+ EE67 C9                   ret
1052+ EE68
1053+ EE68              ; A = coordinate offset -> HL = S.c + (E.c - S.c) * t
1054+ EE68              lerp_c:

1056+ EE6B ED 31                add hl,a
1057+ EE6D 5E                   ld e,(hl)
1058+ EE6E 23                   inc hl
1059+ EE6F 56                   ld d,(hl)
1060+ EE70 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
1061+ EE73 ED 31                add hl,a

1076+ EE88              ;==============================================================================
1077+ EE88              ; Draw one face of the current building
1078+ EE88              ;   HL -> 4 vertex offsets into vtx[] (index*16), df_mask = edges to outline
1079+ EE88              ;   (bit k = edge from corner k to corner k+1)
1080+ EE88              ;==============================================================================
1081+ EE88              draw_face:
1082+ EE88 3A 9E F8             ld a,(face_set)                 ; (corners in a page's upper half, an
1083+ EE8B ED 31                add hl,a                        ; odd occlusion record: the +128 lists)
1084+ EE8D 22 C0 E0             ld (df_ptr),hl

1090+ EEA4 23          >        inc hl

1092+ EEA7 5F          >        ld e,a

1094+ EEA9 5F          >        ld e,a
1095+ EEAA A0          >        and b
1096+ EEAB 47          >        ld b,a
1097+ EEAC 7B          >        ld a,e
1098+ EEAD B1          >        or c
1099+ EEAE 4F          >        ld c,a
1089+ EEAF 7E          >        ld a,(hl)

1092+ EEB3 5F          >        ld e,a

1277+ F049              ;==============================================================================
1278+ F049              ; Convex polygon fill from p2buf (8-bit screen coords).
1279+ F049              ;   Each edge is walked with an exact integer DDA into one of two x tables:
1280+ F049              ;   downward edges -> TA, upward edges -> TB.  For a convex polygon every row

1282+ F049              ;   Winding doesn't matter.

1458+ F14A
1459+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1460+ F14A              ; Span filler.  Rows fy0..fy1, x from TA/TB.  DE = colour pair.
1461+ F14A              ; Short spans use the stack pointer as a 2-byte write pointer into the frame
1462+ F14A              ; buffer (see push_blk), jumping into an unrolled block of PUSH DE.  Spans of
1463+ F14A              ; DMA_SPAN_MIN pixels or more are written by the zxnDMA, which only needs its
1464+ F14A              ; length and destination reloaded (see clear_screen).
1465+ F14A              ; For speed: the stack pointer is kept in IY (ld sp,iy), the rows are
1466+ F14A              ; counted down in IXH, and the table that is the left edge at the polygon's
1467+ F14A              ; middle row is read first, so the left / right swap (still made whenever
1468+ F14A              ; it's needed: a sliver's edges can cross) is mostly skipped.
1469+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1470+ F14A              fill_spans:
1471+ F14A 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1472+ F14D CD 20 E8             call seg_map                    ; first row's section into slot 0
1473+ F150 FD 21 00 00          ld iy,0

1487+ F16A 24                   inc h
1488+ F16B BE                   cp (hl)
1489+ F16C 3E E2                ld a,high TA                    ; TA left (or level): TA first
1490+ F16E 0E 24                ld c,$24                        ;   (inc h)
1491+ F170 38 04                jr c,.ta
1492+ F172 3E E3                ld a,high TB                    ; TB left: TB first
1493+ F174 0E 25                ld c,$25                        ;   (dec h)
1494+ F176 32 7E F1     .ta:    ld (fs_loop+1),a
1495+ F179 79                   ld a,c
1496+ F17A 32 81 F1             ld (fs_loop.tb),a
1497+ F17D
1498+ F17D              fs_loop:
1499+ F17D 26 E2                ld h,high TA                    ; (patched: the left table first)
1500+ F17F 68                   ld l,b
1501+ F180 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1502+ F181 24           .tb:    inc h                           ; (patched: inc h, or dec h, the other)
1503+ F182 4E                   ld c,(hl)
1504+ F183 B9                   cp c
1505+ F184 38 03                jr c,.ord
1506+ F186 69                   ld l,c
1507+ F187 4F                   ld c,a
1508+ F188 7D                   ld a,l
1509+ F189 6F           .ord:   ld l,a                          ; A = left x, C = right x
1510+ F18A 78                   ld a,b
1511+ F18B E6 1F                and 31
1512+ F18D 67                   ld h,a                          ; row within the paged section
1513+ F18E 79                   ld a,c
1514+ F18F 95                   sub l                           ; width-1
1515+ F190 FE 13                cp DMA_SPAN_MIN-1
1516+ F192 30 17                jr nc,.dma
1517+ F194 CB 3F        .push:  srl a
1518+ F196 38 07                jr c,.even
1519+ F198 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; odd width: single pixel first
1520+ F199 B7                   or a
1521+ F19A CA 84 E1             jp z,push_next                  ; (1 pixel: no PUSHes, so SP isn't
1522+ F19D 18 01                jr .go                          ; borrowed: see push_blk)
1523+ F19F 3C           .even:  inc a
1524+ F1A0 69           .go:    ld l,c
1525+ F1A1 23                   inc hl                          ; one past right edge (may be $C000)
1526+ F1A2 F9                   ld sp,hl
1527+ F1A3 6F                   ld l,a
1528+ F1A4 3E 80                ld a,low push_end - 1           ; (the DI before the last PUSH)
1529+ F1A6 95                   sub l
1530+ F1A7 6F                   ld l,a
1531+ F1A8 26 E1                ld h,high push_end
1532+ F1AA E9                   jp (hl)
1533+ F1AB                      ASSERT high push_blk == high push_end && low push_end - 1 - 128 == low push_blk
1534+ F1AB
1535+ F1AB                      ; Long span: zxnDMA from the fixed colour byte (port A) to HL.
1536+ F1AB                      ; Everything but length and destination was set up by clear_screen.
1537+ F1AB 3C           .dma:   inc a
1538+ F1AC 20 03                jr nz,.dmal
1539+ F1AE 3D                   dec a                           ; 256 wide: length needs the high
1540+ F1AF 18 E3                jr .push                        ; byte, so PUSH it (A = width-1)
1541+ F1B1              .dmal:
1542+ F1B1 4F                   ld c,a
1543+ F1B2 3E 25                ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_LO
1544+ F1B4 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1545+ F1B6 79                   ld a,c
1546+ F1B7 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; length = width
1547+ F1B9 3E AD                ld a,DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE
1548+ F1BB D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1549+ F1BD 7D                   ld a,l
1550+ F1BE D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; port B = y*256 + x
1551+ F1C0 7C                   ld a,h
1552+ F1C1 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1553+ F1C3 3E CF                ld a,DMA_LOAD
1554+ F1C5 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1555+ F1C7 3E 87                ld a,DMA_ENABLE
1556+ F1C9 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; CPU waits until the span is written
1557+ F1CB 04                   inc b                           ; the next row (as push_next: SP was
1558+ F1CC DD 25                dec ixh                         ; never borrowed here)
1559+ F1CE C8                   ret z
1560+ F1CF 78                   ld a,b
1561+ F1D0 E6 1F                and 31
1562+ F1D2 C2 7D F1             jp nz,fs_loop
1563+ F1D5 C3 8E E1             jp push_next.sect
1564+ F1D8                      ASSERT high TB == high TA + 1

1566+ F1D8              ;==============================================================================
1567+ F1D8              ; Outline the polygon in p2buf, skipping edges flagged 0 (clip edges)
1568+ F1D8              ;==============================================================================
1569+ F1D8              outline_poly:
1570+ F1D8 DD 21 80 E0          ld ix,p2buf
1571+ F1DC 3A E8 E0             ld a,(p2n)
1572+ F1DF 47                   ld b,a
1573+ F1E0 C5           .lp:    push bc
1574+ F1E1 DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
1575+ F1E4 B7                   or a
1576+ F1E5 28 0F                jr z,.sk
1577+ F1E7 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
1578+ F1EA DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1579+ F1ED DD 5E 04             ld e,(ix+4)
1580+ F1F0 DD 56 05             ld d,(ix+5)
1581+ F1F3 CD FF F1             call draw_line

1583+ F1F9 DD 09                add ix,bc
1584+ F1FB C1                   pop bc
1585+ F1FC 10 E2                djnz .lp
1586+ F1FE C9                   ret

1588+ F1FF              ;==============================================================================
1589+ F1FF              ; Bresenham line, on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
1590+ F1FF              ;   L = x0, H = y0, E = x1, D = y1, colour in line_col.  Preserves IX, IY.
1591+ F1FF              ;   Pages Layer 2 sections into slot 0 as the line crosses them.
1592+ F1FF              ;==============================================================================
1593+ F1FF              draw_line:
1594+ F1FF 3A EC E0             ld a,(line_col)
1595+ F202 4F                   ld c,a
1596+ F203 7B                   ld a,e
1597+ F204 95                   sub l
1598+ F205 30 06                jr nc,.xp
1599+ F207 ED 44                neg
1600+ F209 06 2D                ld b,OP_DEC_L
1601+ F20B 18 02                jr .xd
1602+ F20D 06 2C        .xp:    ld b,OP_INC_L
1603+ F20F 5F           .xd:    ld e,a                          ; |dx|
1604+ F210 78                   ld a,b
1605+ F211 32 39 F2             ld (.smx1),a
1606+ F214 32 56 F2             ld (.smx2),a
1607+ F217 7A                   ld a,d
1608+ F218 94                   sub h
1609+ F219 30 06                jr nc,.yp
1610+ F21B ED 44                neg
1611+ F21D 06 25                ld b,OP_DEC_H
1612+ F21F 18 02                jr .yd
1613+ F221 06 24        .yp:    ld b,OP_INC_H
1614+ F223 57           .yd:    ld d,a                          ; |dy|
1615+ F224 78                   ld a,b
1616+ F225 32 3D F2             ld (.smy1),a
1617+ F228 32 4D F2             ld (.smy2),a
1618+ F22B 7C                   ld a,h
1619+ F22C CD 20 E8             call seg_map                    ; page in the start row's section
1620+ F22F 67                   ld h,a                          ; y within the section
1621+ F230 7B                   ld a,e
1622+ F231 BA                   cp d
1623+ F232 38 13                jr c,.ymaj
1624+ F234 43                   ld b,e
1625+ F235 04                   inc b
1626+ F236 CB 3F                srl a
1627+ F238 71           .xl:    ld (hl),c
1628+ F239 2C           .smx1:  inc l
1629+ F23A 92                   sub d
1630+ F23B 30 07                jr nc,.xs
1631+ F23D 24           .smy1:  inc h
1632+ F23E CB 6C                bit 5,h                         ; left the 32-row section?
1633+ F240 C4 37 E8             call nz,line_seg
1634+ F243 83                   add a,e
1635+ F244 10 F2        .xs:    djnz .xl
1636+ F246 C9                   ret
1637+ F247 42           .ymaj:  ld b,d
1638+ F248 04                   inc b
1639+ F249 7A                   ld a,d
1640+ F24A CB 3F                srl a
1641+ F24C 71           .yl:    ld (hl),c
1642+ F24D 24           .smy2:  inc h
1643+ F24E CB 6C                bit 5,h
1644+ F250 C4 37 E8             call nz,line_seg
1645+ F253 93                   sub e
1646+ F254 30 02                jr nc,.ys
1647+ F256 2C           .smx2:  inc l
1648+ F257 82                   add a,d
1649+ F258 10 F2        .ys:    djnz .yl
1650+ F25A C9                   ret
1651+ F25B
1652+ F25B              ;==============================================================================
1653+ F25B              ; Clear the viewport (rows 0..VIEW_H-1) of the back buffer with the zxnDMA,
1654+ F25B              ; one 8K section (32 rows) at a time through slot 0: sky above the horizon
1655+ F25B              ; row, ground below.  The fills are dma_fill's (layer2_cls.asm, resident),
1656+ F25B              ; the l2_fill command block with its destination (port B) and length; the source
1657+ F25B              ; (port A) is the fixed byte l2_cls_byte.  Zero-length fills are skipped.
1658+ F25B              ;==============================================================================
1659+ F25B              clear_screen:
1660+ F25B 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; C = first row of the section
1661+ F25D 79           .sec:   ld a,c
1662+ F25E CD 20 E8             call seg_map
1663+ F261 3A 58 B6             ld a,(horizon)                  ; sky rows here = clamp(hz - C, 0, 32)
1664+ F264                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1665+ F264 3C                   inc a                           ; the horizon row too: at the horizon
1666+ F265                                                      ; it is all distant wall, and it hides
1667+ F265                                                      ; a 1-row rounding gap under the
1668+ F265                                                      ; wall's top edge when pitched
1669+ F265                  ENDIF
1670+ F265 91                   sub c
1671+ F266 30 01                jr nc,.s1
1672+ F268 AF                   xor a
1673+ F269 FE 21        .s1:    cp 33
1674+ F26B 38 02                jr c,.s2
1675+ F26D 3E 20                ld a,32
1676+ F26F 32 EE E0     .s2:    ld (cs_sky),a
1677+ F272 B7                   or a
1678+ F273 28 0D                jr z,.gnd
1679+ F275 C5                   push bc
1680+ F276 47                   ld b,a                          ; sky: section start, rows*256 bytes
1681+ F277 0E 00                ld c,0
1682+ F279 21 00 00             ld hl,0
1683+ F27C                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1684+ F27C 3E 01                ld a,WALL_FAMILY*4+SHADE_FACE   ; "sky" is the perimeter wall
1685+ F27E                  ELSE
1686+ F27E ~                    ld a,SKY_COL
1687+ F27E                  ENDIF
1688+ F27E CD FF A7             call dma_fill
1689+ F281 C1                   pop bc
1690+ F282 3A EE E0     .gnd:   ld a,(cs_sky)
1691+ F285 FE 20                cp 32
1692+ F287 28 11                jr z,.nx
1693+ F289 C5                   push bc
1694+ F28A 67                   ld h,a                          ; ground: after the sky rows
1695+ F28B 2E 00                ld l,0
1696+ F28D ED 44                neg
1697+ F28F C6 20                add a,32
1698+ F291 47                   ld b,a
1699+ F292 0E 00                ld c,0
1700+ F294 3E 07                ld a,GROUND_COL
1701+ F296 CD FF A7             call dma_fill
1702+ F299 C1                   pop bc
1703+ F29A 79           .nx:    ld a,c
1704+ F29B C6 20                add a,32
1705+ F29D 4F                   ld c,a
1706+ F29E FE 80                cp VIEW_H
1707+ F2A0 20 BB                jr nz,.sec
1708+ F2A2                      ; Leave the DMA ready for fill_spans: length high byte 0, so each span
1709+ F2A2                      ; only reloads length low, destination, LOAD and ENABLE.  fill_poly
1710+ F2A2                      ; puts each building's colour in the source byte l2_cls_byte.
1711+ F2A2 3E 45        .spans: ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_HI
1712+ F2A4 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1713+ F2A6 AF                   xor a
1714+ F2A7 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1715+ F2A9 C9                   ret
1716+ F2AA
1717+ F2AA
1718+ F2AA              ;==============================================================================
1719+ F2AA              ; City traversal - back to front without sorting.
1720+ F2AA              ;   For grid-aligned boxes in separate cells, a box can only hide boxes whose
1721+ F2AA              ;   cell offsets from the camera cell are larger (or equal) on both axes in
1722+ F2AA              ;   the same quadrant.  So: rows from the far edges inwards, and within each
1723+ F2AA              ;   row columns from the far edges inwards, the camera row/column last.
1724+ F2AA              ;==============================================================================
1725+ F2AA              draw_city:
1726+ F2AA CD 65 F3             call walk_patch                 ; this frame's cell steps
1727+ F2AD                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1728+ F2AD CD 12 85             call occ_begin
1729+ F2B0 3A C1 F8             ld a,(occ_on)
1730+ F2B3 B7                   or a
1731+ F2B4 28 13                jr z,draw_cells                 ; pitched: the painter's order as is
1732+ F2B6 CD 4A 85             call occ_cells                  ; front to back: keep what isn't hidden
1733+ F2B9 3A C2 F8             ld a,(occ_full)
1734+ F2BC B7                   or a
1735+ F2BD CA 8E 88             jp z,occ_draw_list              ; back to front: draw it
1736+ F2C0 AF                   xor a                           ; too many to keep: draw this frame
1737+ F2C1 32 C1 F8             ld (occ_on),a                   ; the plain way
1738+ F2C4 3E 80                ld a,VIEW_H
1739+ F2C6 32 F5 F8             ld (bld_cut),a                  ; (and nothing cut)
1740+ F2C9                  ENDIF
1741+ F2C9              draw_cells:
1742+ F2C9 3A 7E B6             ld a,(cz)
1743+ F2CC 21 AE AF             ld hl,view_r
1744+ F2CF 96                   sub (hl)
1745+ F2D0 32 A6 F8             ld (cell_j),a
1746+ F2D3 3A A6 F8     .b:     ld a,(cell_j)
1747+ F2D6 21 7E B6             ld hl,cz
1748+ F2D9 BE                   cp (hl)
1749+ F2DA 28 09                jr z,.f
1750+ F2DC CD 01 F3             call draw_row
1751+ F2DF 21 A6 F8             ld hl,cell_j
1752+ F2E2 34                   inc (hl)
1753+ F2E3 18 EE                jr .b
1754+ F2E5 3A 7E B6     .f:     ld a,(cz)
1755+ F2E8 21 AE AF             ld hl,view_r
1756+ F2EB 86                   add a,(hl)
1757+ F2EC 32 A6 F8             ld (cell_j),a
1758+ F2EF 3A A6 F8     .f2:    ld a,(cell_j)
1759+ F2F2 21 7E B6             ld hl,cz
1760+ F2F5 BE                   cp (hl)
1761+ F2F6 28 09                jr z,draw_row                   ; camera row last
1762+ F2F8 CD 01 F3             call draw_row
1763+ F2FB 21 A6 F8             ld hl,cell_j
1764+ F2FE 35                   dec (hl)
1765+ F2FF 18 EE                jr .f2
1766+ F301
1767+ F301              ; The cell walks (draw_row here, occ_row in city2.asm) keep the cell's
1768+ F301              ; yaw-space centre (X, Z1) in the alternate registers HL', DE' (nothing else
1769+ F301              ; uses the alternate set, the interrupt routine included), and step it one
1770+ F301              ; cell at a time by (cosY, sinY), patched into the steps each frame
1771+ F301              ; (walk_patch).  draw_bld reads it from there.
1772+ F301              draw_row:
1773+ F301 3A A6 F8             ld a,(cell_j)
1774+ F304 FE 40                cp GRID
1775+ F306 D0                   ret nc
1776+ F307 CD 84 F3             call row_base
1777+ F30A 3A 7D B6             ld a,(cx)
1778+ F30D 21 AE AF             ld hl,view_r
1779+ F310 96                   sub (hl)
1780+ F311 32 A5 F8             ld (cell_i),a
1781+ F314 CD A3 F3             call row_start
1782+ F317 3A A5 F8     .l:     ld a,(cell_i)
1783+ F31A 21 7D B6             ld hl,cx
1784+ F31D BE                   cp (hl)
1785+ F31E 28 15                jr z,.r
1786+ F320 CD D0 F3             call try_cell
1787+ F323 21 A5 F8             ld hl,cell_i
1788+ F326 34                   inc (hl)
1789+ F327 D9                   exx                             ; one cell +x: (X,Z1) += (cosY,sinY)
1790+ F328 01 00 00     .cp:    ld bc,0                         ; (cosY: walk_patch)
1791+ F32B 09                   add hl,bc
1792+ F32C EB                   ex de,hl
1793+ F32D 01 00 00     .sp:    ld bc,0                         ; (sinY)
1794+ F330 09                   add hl,bc
1795+ F331 EB                   ex de,hl
1796+ F332 D9                   exx
1797+ F333 18 E2                jr .l
1798+ F335 3A 7D B6     .r:     ld a,(cx)
1799+ F338 21 AE AF             ld hl,view_r
1800+ F33B 86                   add a,(hl)
1801+ F33C 32 A5 F8             ld (cell_i),a
1802+ F33F CD A3 F3             call row_start
1803+ F342 3A A5 F8     .r2:    ld a,(cell_i)
1804+ F345 21 7D B6             ld hl,cx
1805+ F348 BE                   cp (hl)
1806+ F349 CA D0 F3             jp z,try_cell                   ; camera column last
1807+ F34C CD D0 F3             call try_cell
1808+ F34F 21 A5 F8             ld hl,cell_i
1809+ F352 35                   dec (hl)
1810+ F353 D9                   exx                             ; one cell -x
1811+ F354 01 00 00     .cm:    ld bc,0                         ; (cosY)
1812+ F357 B7                   or a
1813+ F358 ED 42                sbc hl,bc
1814+ F35A EB                   ex de,hl
1815+ F35B 01 00 00     .sm:    ld bc,0                         ; (sinY)
1816+ F35E B7                   or a
1817+ F35F ED 42                sbc hl,bc
1818+ F361 EB                   ex de,hl
1819+ F362 D9                   exx
1820+ F363 18 DD                jr .r2
1821+ F365
1822+ F365              ; This frame's (cosY, sinY) into the cell walks' steps (draw_row, occ_row)
1823+ F365              walk_patch:
1824+ F365 2A 5B B6             ld hl,(cos_y)
1825+ F368 22 29 F3             ld (draw_row.cp+1),hl
1826+ F36B 22 55 F3             ld (draw_row.cm+1),hl
1827+ F36E                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1828+ F36E 22 A8 85             ld (occ_row.cp+1),hl
1829+ F371 22 E2 85             ld (occ_row.cm+1),hl
1830+ F374                  ENDIF
1831+ F374 2A 59 B6             ld hl,(sin_y)
1832+ F377 22 2E F3             ld (draw_row.sp+1),hl
1833+ F37A 22 5C F3             ld (draw_row.sm+1),hl
1834+ F37D                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1835+ F37D 22 AD 85             ld (occ_row.sp+1),hl
1836+ F380 22 E9 85             ld (occ_row.sm+1),hl
1837+ F383                  ENDIF
1838+ F383 C9                   ret
1839+ F384
1840+ F384              ; A = cell_j: its row's first city_map byte (city_map + j * GRID) -> cell_row
1841+ F384              row_base:
1842+ F384 6F                   ld l,a
1843+ F385 26 00                ld h,0
1844+ F387                      ROWOFS
1844+ F387 29          >        add hl,hl
1844+ F388 29          >        add hl,hl
1844+ F389 29          >        add hl,hl
1844+ F38A 29          >        add hl,hl
1844+ F38B 29          >        add hl,hl
1844+ F38C 29          >        add hl,hl
1845+ F38D 11 00 70             ld de,city_map
1846+ F390 19                   add hl,de
1847+ F391 22 BC F8             ld (cell_row),hl
1848+ F394 C9                   ret
1849+ F395
1850+ F395              ; HL = v, A = k -> HL = v * k, modulo 65536: exactly v added k times (k
1851+ F395              ; small, its product with each byte of v at most 16 bits).  Keeps BC.
1852+ F395              kmul:
1853+ F395 5F                   ld e,a
1854+ F396 55                   ld d,l
1855+ F397 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; low byte * k
1856+ F399 D5                   push de
1857+ F39A 54                   ld d,h
1858+ F39B 5F                   ld e,a
1859+ F39C ED 30                mul d,e                         ; high byte * k: its low byte counts
1860+ F39E 7B                   ld a,e
1861+ F39F E1                   pop hl
1862+ F3A0 84                   add a,h
1863+ F3A1 67                   ld h,a
1864+ F3A2 C9                   ret
1865+ F3A3
1866+ F3A3              ; Yaw-rotated centre of cell (cell_i, cell_j) -> (X, Z1) in HL', DE' (the
1867+ F3A3              ; cell walks').  Moving one cell (256 units) in x then changes (X, Z1) by
1868+ F3A3              ; exactly the raw (cosY, sinY).
1869+ F3A3              row_start:
1870+ F3A3 3A A5 F8             ld a,(cell_i)
1871+ F3A6 67                   ld h,a
1872+ F3A7 2E 80                ld l,128
1873+ F3A9 ED 5B 94 AF          ld de,(cam_x+1)
1874+ F3AD B7                   or a
1875+ F3AE ED 52                sbc hl,de
1876+ F3B0 22 B4 F8             ld (t_dx),hl
1877+ F3B3 3A A6 F8             ld a,(cell_j)
1878+ F3B6 67                   ld h,a
1879+ F3B7 2E 80                ld l,128
1880+ F3B9 ED 5B 97 AF          ld de,(cam_z+1)
1881+ F3BD B7                   or a
1882+ F3BE ED 52                sbc hl,de
1883+ F3C0 22 B6 F8             ld (t_dz),hl
1884+ F3C3 CD 0B F8             call rot_yaw
1885+ F3C6 E5                   push hl                         ; X
1886+ F3C7 2A B8 F8             ld hl,(t_z1)
1887+ F3CA E5                   push hl                         ; Z1
1888+ F3CB D9                   exx
1889+ F3CC D1                   pop de
1890+ F3CD E1                   pop hl
1891+ F3CE D9                   exx
1892+ F3CF C9                   ret
1893+ F3D0
1894+ F3D0              try_cell:
1895+ F3D0 3A A5 F8             ld a,(cell_i)
1896+ F3D3 FE 40                cp GRID
1897+ F3D5 D0                   ret nc
1898+ F3D6                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1899+ F3D6 ~                    call vtick                      ; keep the FPS clock sampling
1900+ F3D6                  ENDIF
1901+ F3D6                      ; fall through
1902+ F3D6
1903+ F3D6              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1904+ F3D6              ; Transform and draw the building in (cell_i, cell_j)
1905+ F3D6              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1906+ F3D6              draw_cell:
1907+ F3D6 2A BC F8             ld hl,(cell_row)                ; (the row's first map byte: row_base)
1908+ F3D9 3A A5 F8             ld a,(cell_i)
1909+ F3DC ED 31                add hl,a
1910+ F3DE 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1911+ F3DF 4F                   ld c,a
1912+ F3E0 E6 1F                and CELL_CODE
1913+ F3E2 20 1A                jr nz,.nst
1914+ F3E4                      ; street: the zombies and humans standing there (bits 7, 6)
1915+ F3E4 79                   ld a,c
1916+ F3E5 E6 C0                and CELL_ZOMBIE|CELL_HUMAN
1917+ F3E7 C8                   ret z                           ; nobody
1918+ F3E8                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1919+ F3E8 3A C1 F8             ld a,(occ_on)
1920+ F3EB B7                   or a

   1+ 8000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 8000              ; Z-POLICE - the second city page (8K page PAGE_CITY2, runs at $8000 in slot
   3+ 8000              ; 4: CITY2_MMU)
   4+ 8000              ;
   5+ 8000              ; More of the Layer 2 drawing, paged in beside the city page (slot 7) for the
   6+ 8000              ; city part of each frame: main_loop maps it over the ULA screen after
   7+ 8000              ; clear_screen and puts the ULA screen back before draw_hud.  Nothing in that
   8+ 8000              ; part of the frame uses the ULA screen (the video hardware shows it from
   9+ 8000              ; bank 5 whatever the CPU has mapped), and the interrupt routine uses only
  10+ 8000              ; slots 1 and 5, so interrupts stay on.  Both pages are mapped together, so
  11+ 8000              ; code and data in either call or use the other directly (labels are global).
  12+ 8000              ;
  13+ 8000              ; Here: the street dots, the bullets, rockets and particles, the gunsight and
  14+ 8000              ; the occlusion culling.  Their variables stay in the city page.  Anything
  15+ 8000              ; that calls into this page from outside main_loop's city part must map it
  16+ 8000              ; first (nextreg CITY2_MMU,PAGE_CITY2) and put the ULA screen back after.
  17+ 8000              ;==============================================================================
  18+ 8000
  19+ 8000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ 8000              ; Street intersection markers - one dot per grid corner near the camera
  21+ 8000              ; whose 4 cells are all open: no building, terrace or pad cell touches it
  22+ 8000              ; (out of bounds counts as open: it is never drawn).  A corner a building
  23+ 8000              ; touches is always drawn over by it (its faces cover their own corners, and
  24+ 8000              ; the box hides those behind it), so it isn't worked out at all.
  25+ 8000              ;   A row's corners have cells j-1 above and j below; each corner shares its
  26+ 8000              ; left pair of cells with the corner before, so one pair is read a corner.
  27+ 8000              ; An open corner's (X, Z1) is its row's first corner's (worked out once, by
  28+ 8000              ; full rotation, only if the row has an open corner) + k (cosY, sinY), k its
  29+ 8000              ; column in the row: exactly what stepping +256 world units k times gives.
  30+ 8000              ;==============================================================================

 743+ 8512                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
 744+ 8512              ;==============================================================================
 745+ 8512              ; Occlusion culling (OCCLUSION_CULL, level flight only)
 746+ 8512              ;
 747+ 8512              ; In level flight every screen column is a vertical slice of the world through
 748+ 8512              ; the camera.  The cells are walked in exactly the reverse of the painter's
 749+ 8512              ; order, i.e. front to back.  Each building is transformed as usual, then
 750+ 8512              ; tested against OCC_YBUF, which holds per column the row from which the
 751+ 8512              ; screen is known to be covered down to the ground:
 752+ 8512              ;   * hidden - in every column it spans, its highest point is no higher than
 753+ 8512              ;     that row - it is dropped;
 754+ 8512              ;   * otherwise it lowers the row across its columns to its lowest top
 755+ 8512              ;     corner, and its corners and face settings are kept in a record.
 756+ 8512              ; The kept buildings and the zombie cells are then drawn back to front.
 757+ 8512              ; This is safe because buildings that share a column meet the walk front to
 758+ 8512              ; back (the grid order guarantees it), the camera is above the ground (what
 759+ 8512              ; is behind sits higher on screen), the cover row is the lowest top corner
 760+ 8512              ; (an underestimate) and bounds are clamped inwards to the screen.  A
 761+ 8512              ; building with a corner behind the camera is never dropped and never covers.
 762+ 8512              ;==============================================================================
 763+ 8512              OCC_YBUF        equ $4000       ; per column: covered from this row down
 764+ 8512              OCC_YBUF8       equ $4200       ; per 8 columns: at least the most of
 765+ 8512                                              ; OCC_YBUF's 8 (its own page, before the
 766+ 8512                                              ; records), so a hidden test can pass 8
 767+ 8512                                              ; columns at once
 768+ 8512              OCC_LIST        equ $4100       ; kept buildings and zombie cells, 2 bytes each
 769+ 8512              OCC_REC0        equ $43         ; the records' first page; two records a
 770+ 8512              OCC_RECN        equ $60         ; page (128 bytes each, at +0 and +128), up
 771+ 8512                                              ; to $5F: 58 records ($6000 on: city_col).
 772+ 8512                                              ; The busiest street view at the full draw
 773+ 8512                                              ; distance (8 tiles) keeps 35.
 774+ 8512              ; Record: copy of vtx's 8 corners, bytes 0-8 of each 16 (X, Y, Z, outcode,
 775+ 8512              ; sx, sy), at the same offsets from the record's start, and in the first
 776+ 8512              ; corner's spare bytes
 777+ 8512              OR_VIS          equ 9           ; bld_vis, bld_mx, bld_mz, col_x, col_z, col_top,
 778+ 8512              OR_N            equ 7           ;   bld_cut
 779+ 8512                      ASSERT OR_VIS + OR_N <= 16
 780+ 8512                      ASSERT bld_cut == bld_vis + OR_N - 1
 781+ 8512                      ASSERT low OCC_YBUF8 == 0       ; (occ_cut: the low byte is the group)
 782+ 8512              ; A record in a page's upper half is drawn with the +128 corner lists
 783+ 8512              ; (face_set = FACE_SET2, city.asm).
 784+ 8512              ; A list entry is a record's address ($4300-$5FFF), a cell with humans as
 785+ 8512              ; its city_col address ($6000-$6FFF) or a cell with zombies as its city_map
 786+ 8512              ; address ($7000-$7FFF).
 787+ 8512
 788+ 8512              ; Start of the city: occlusion on only in level flight
 789+ 8512              occ_begin:
 790+ 8512 AF                   xor a
 791+ 8513 32 C1 F8             ld (occ_on),a
 792+ 8516 32 C2 F8             ld (occ_full),a
 793+ 8519 3A 9E AF             ld a,(pitch)
 794+ 851C B7                   or a
 795+ 851D C0                   ret nz
 796+ 851E 3C                   inc a
 797+ 851F 32 C1 F8             ld (occ_on),a
 798+ 8522 21 00 41             ld hl,OCC_LIST
 799+ 8525 22 C3 F8             ld (occ_lp),hl
 800+ 8528 21 00 43             ld hl,OCC_REC0*256
 801+ 852B 22 C5 F8             ld (occ_rp),hl
 802+ 852E 21 00 40             ld hl,OCC_YBUF                  ; nothing covered yet: by DMA (about
 803+ 8531 01 00 01             ld bc,256                       ; 1,500 T less than an LDIR), then
 804+ 8534 3E 80                ld a,VIEW_H                     ; the DMA left ready for the spans
 805+ 8536 CD FF A7             call dma_fill
 806+ 8539 CD A2 F2             call clear_screen.spans
 807+ 853C 21 00 42             ld hl,OCC_YBUF8                 ; (and so in every group of 8)
 808+ 853F 36 80                ld (hl),VIEW_H
 809+ 8541 11 01 42             ld de,OCC_YBUF8+1
 810+ 8544 01 1F 00             ld bc,31
 811+ 8547 ED B0                ldir
 812+ 8549 C9                   ret

1062+ 86DF                      ; clear_screen.spans).  (Only bytes 0-8 of each corner are used:

1435+ 8909              ;==============================================================================
1436+ 8909              ; The figures (zombies, special monsters, humans): their graphics are in
1437+ 8909              ; pages PAGE_GFX0 on (ZPDATA/SPRITES.ZPG, loaded at start-up: gfx_load,
1438+ 8909              ; level_load.asm; tools/spritefile.py has the format), each mapped at $C000
1439+ 8909              ; (slot 6: the game logic's, free while the city is drawn) when needed.
1440+ 8909              ; fig_draw (zombie page) projects the figure and calls spr_lod for its
1441+ 8909              ; size, then spr_draw.
1442+ 8909              ;==============================================================================
1443+ 8909                      ASSERT GFX_ENTRIES*4 <= 256     ; (the purpose table in one 256 bytes)
1444+ 8909                      ASSERT GFX_ENTRIES == 2*GFX_ANIMS   ; (the purposes, their vision set)
1445+ 8909                      ASSERT low GFX_DIR == 0
1446+ 8909
1447+ 8909              ; The level of detail for the figure's distance: fig_anim's frame fig_frame
1448+ 8909              ; (wrapped round its frames) at the level whose min_z is the largest not
1449+ 8909              ; past Z (zt+4; the levels are listed farthest first, the last's min_z 0).
1450+ 8909              ; In a vision mode (vision_mode not 0) from the vision set: the directory's
1451+ 8909              ; entries GFX_ANIMS on.  Sets zw, zh, spr_pg and spr_ptr.  Carry set if
1452+ 8909              ; there are no graphics.
1453+ 8909              spr_lod:

1455+ 890C B7                   or a
1456+ 890D 37                   scf
1457+ 890E C8                   ret z

1464+ 891E 87           .set:   add a,a
