 343+ C25C
 344+ C25C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 345+ C25C              ; The missile lock, each frame in flight.  With the missile pod selected the
 346+ C25C              ; reticule is shown (ret_on).  Searching (lock_state 0), it wanders the view.
 347+ C25C              ; A monster drawn last frame (fig_seen: +31) within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL
 348+ C25C              ; along x and z, the nearest, becomes the target (lock_tgt): locking (1),
 349+ C25C              ; the reticule moves to where it was drawn (+32, +33) at RET_STEP pixels a
 350+ C25C              ; frame, and after LOCK_TIME frames on it (within LOCK_NEAR) the target is
 351+ C25C              ; locked (2): the lock tone, and the reticule stays on it.  The target lost
 352+ C25C              ; (killed, out of view, out of range) it searches again.  Then the drawn
 353+ C25C              ; marks are cleared for this frame's drawing.
 354+ C25C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 355+ C25C              lock_update:
 356+ C25C CD 16 C9             call sel_slot
 357+ C25F 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 358+ C260 FE 05                cp WPN_MISSILE
 359+ C262 C2 EF C2             jp nz,lock_off
 360+ C265 3E 01                ld a,1
 361+ C267 32 19 B0             ld (ret_on),a
 362+ C26A 3A 1D B0             ld a,(lock_tgt)
 363+ C26D FE FF                cp $FF
 364+ C26F 28 0B                jr z,.find
 365+ C271 CD 1F C3             call lk_rec
 366+ C274 CD 2B C3             call lk_valid
 367+ C277 30 1C                jr nc,.have
 368+ C279 CD 12 C3             call lk_lose                    ; the target lost
 369+ C27C CD 75 C3     .find:  call lk_nearest                 ; a new one?
 370+ C27F FE FF                cp $FF
 371+ C281 28 42                jr z,.wander
 372+ C283 32 1D B0             ld (lock_tgt),a
 373+ C286 3E 01                ld a,1
 374+ C288 32 1C B0             ld (lock_state),a
 375+ C28B AF                   xor a
 376+ C28C 32 1E B0             ld (lock_t),a
 377+ C28F 3A 1D B0             ld a,(lock_tgt)
 378+ C292 CD 1F C3             call lk_rec
 379+ C295 CD B1 C3     .have:  call lk_spot                    ; C, B = where it was drawn
 380+ C298 3A 1C B0             ld a,(lock_state)
 381+ C29B FE 02                cp 2
 382+ C29D 20 0A                jr nz,.move
 383+ C29F 79                   ld a,c                          ; locked: on it
 384+ C2A0 32 1A B0             ld (ret_x),a

 386+ C2A4 32 1B B0             ld (ret_y),a
 387+ C2A7 18 57                jr lk_clear
 388+ C2A9 1E 04        .move:  ld e,RET_STEP
 389+ C2AB CD D2 C3             call ret_toward
 390+ C2AE 30 50                jr nc,lk_clear                  ; not on it yet
 391+ C2B0 21 1E B0             ld hl,lock_t
 392+ C2B3 34                   inc (hl)
 393+ C2B4 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 394+ C2B5 FE 1C                cp LOCK_TIME
 395+ C2B7 38 47                jr c,lk_clear
 396+ C2B9 3E 02                ld a,2                          ; locked
 397+ C2BB 32 1C B0             ld (lock_state),a
 398+ C2BE 3E 0D                ld a,SFX_LOCK
 399+ C2C0 32 67 3A             ld (sfx_req),a
 400+ C2C3 18 3B                jr lk_clear
 401+ C2C5              .wander:
 402+ C2C5 3A 1F B0             ld a,(wnd_x)
 403+ C2C8 4F                   ld c,a
 404+ C2C9 3A 20 B0             ld a,(wnd_y)
 405+ C2CC 47                   ld b,a
 406+ C2CD 1E 02                ld e,RET_WANDER
 407+ C2CF CD D2 C3             call ret_toward
 408+ C2D2 30 2C                jr nc,lk_clear
 409+ C2D4 CD 30 26             call zrand                      ; there: somewhere new, within
 410+ C2D7 55                   ld d,l                          ; RET_WANDER_R of the view's centre
 411+ C2D8 1E 51                ld e,2*RET_WANDER_R+1
 412+ C2DA ED 30                mul d,e                         ; D = 0..2*RET_WANDER_R
 413+ C2DC 7A                   ld a,d
 414+ C2DD C6 58                add a,128-RET_WANDER_R

 416+ C2E2 54                   ld d,h

 798+ C57A              ; A = the angle wanted, HL = B_YAW or B_PIT: turn missile IX's angle there

 845+ C5C4
 846+ C5C4              ; HL = x, DE = z (signed) -> A = the angle of (x, z) from +z towards +x,
 847+ C5C4              ; 256 a turn (as yaw: 64 = +x).  0 for (0, 0).  For a climb, HL = dy and

1316+ C920
1317+ C920              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1318+ C920              ; Landed (update_weapons): on the base pad, repair and reload.  The VTOL
1319+ C920              ; gains 1 hit point every REPAIR_FRAMES frames up to VTOL_HP; each slot
1320+ C920              ; whose weapon reloads (wpn_cfg, zpolice.asm: its full load and frames a
1321+ C920              ; shot) gains a
1322+ C920              ; shot every that many frames up to its full load.  The counts start afresh
1323+ C920              ; each landing (svc_on), so a shot or hit point takes the whole interval.
1324+ C920              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1325+ C920              pad_service:
1326+ C920 CD B8 AA             call cam_cell_ptr
1327+ C923 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1328+ C924 E6 1F                and CELL_CODE
1329+ C926 FE 10                cp PAD_CODE

1333+ C92E C9                   ret

1335+ C932 B7                   or a
1336+ C933 20 13                jr nz,.go
1337+ C935 3C                   inc a                           ; just landed: start the counts
1338+ C936 32 0E D2             ld (svc_on),a
1339+ C939 3E 05                ld a,REPAIR_FRAMES
1340+ C93B 32 0F D2             ld (svc_rep),a

1342+ C941 06 05                ld b,WPN_SLOTS

1344+ C945 23                   inc hl
1345+ C946 10 FB                djnz .cl

1347+ C94B B7                   or a
1348+ C94C 28 0B                jr z,.nf
1349+ C94E 3A 3D B0             ld a,(boost_fuel)
1350+ C951 FE C8                cp BOOST_FUEL_MAX
1351+ C953 30 04                jr nc,.nf
1352+ C955 3C                   inc a
1353+ C956 32 3D B0             ld (boost_fuel),a
1354+ C959 21 0F D2     .nf:    ld hl,svc_rep                   ; repair
1355+ C95C 35                   dec (hl)
1356+ C95D 20 0D                jr nz,.rl
1357+ C95F 36 05                ld (hl),REPAIR_FRAMES
1358+ C961 3A B0 AF             ld a,(vtol_hp)
1359+ C964 FE 32                cp VTOL_HP
1360+ C966 30 04                jr nc,.rl                       ; (undamaged)
1361+ C968 3C                   inc a
1362+ C969 32 B0 AF             ld (vtol_hp),a
1363+ C96C DD 21 A0 AF  .rl:    ld ix,wpn_slots                 ; reload, slot by slot
1364+ C970 21 10 D2             ld hl,svc_rel
1365+ C973 06 05                ld b,WPN_SLOTS
1366+ C975 C5           .sl:    push bc
1367+ C976 DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+WPN_TYPE)
1368+ C979 E5                   push hl
1369+ C97A CD 12 AB             call wpn_cfg_ptr                ; (resident)
1370+ C97D 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1371+ C97E 4F                   ld c,a                          ; C = its full load (WCFG_LOAD)
1372+ C97F 23                   inc hl
1373+ C980 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; frames a shot (WCFG_RELOAD)
1374+ C981 E1                   pop hl
1375+ C982 B7                   or a
1376+ C983 28 16                jr z,.nx                        ; doesn't reload (or an empty slot)
1377+ C985 47                   ld b,a                          ; B = frames a shot
1378+ C986 DD 7E 01             ld a,(ix+WPN_AMMO)
1379+ C989 B9                   cp c
1380+ C98A 30 0D                jr nc,.full
1381+ C98C 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1382+ C98D B7                   or a
1383+ C98E 20 01                jr nz,.cnt
1384+ C990 70                   ld (hl),b                       ; a new interval
1385+ C991 35           .cnt:   dec (hl)
1386+ C992 20 07                jr nz,.nx
1387+ C994 DD 34 01             inc (ix+WPN_AMMO)               ; one more shot
1388+ C997 18 02                jr .nx
1389+ C999 36 00        .full:  ld (hl),0
1390+ C99B 23           .nx:    inc hl
1391+ C99C DD 23                inc ix
1392+ C99E DD 23                inc ix
1393+ C9A0 C1                   pop bc
1394+ C9A1 10 D2                djnz .sl
1395+ C9A3 C9                   ret
1396+ C9A4
1397+ C9A4              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1398+ C9A4              ; Pulse laser: SPACE held with the laser in the centre slot fires a beam for
1399+ C9A4              ; LASER_ON frames, then it cools for LASER_COOL frames.  Each beam frame the
1400+ C9A4              ; beam is traced from the muzzle along the current view direction (the round
1401+ C9A4              ; walk, LASER_RANGE long) to the first building, ground or zombie, killing a
1402+ C9A4              ; zombie it reaches.  It is kept in laser_rec as a round (state 3) whose
1403+ C9A4              ; path runs from the muzzle to where the beam stops; draw_bullets clips it
1404+ C9A4              ; to the view, so it rises from the bottom edge of the screen.
1405+ C9A4              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1406+ C9A4              laser_update:
1407+ C9A4 3A 15 D2             ld a,(las_on)
1408+ C9A7 B7                   or a
1409+ C9A8 20 25                jr nz,.beam
1410+ C9AA 32 68 B3             ld (laser_rec+B_STATE),a        ; no beam this frame
1411+ C9AD 3A 16 D2             ld a,(las_cool)
1412+ C9B0 B7                   or a
1413+ C9B1 28 05                jr z,.ready
1414+ C9B3 3D                   dec a                           ; cooling down
1415+ C9B4 32 16 D2             ld (las_cool),a
1416+ C9B7 C9                   ret
1417+ C9B8 CD 16 C9     .ready: call sel_slot
1418+ C9BB 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1419+ C9BC FE 02                cp WPN_LASER
1420+ C9BE C0                   ret nz
1421+ C9BF 3E 09                ld a,K_FIRE
1422+ C9C1 CD BE E0             call key_held
1423+ C9C4 C8                   ret z

1425+ C9C7 32 15 D2             ld (las_on),a
1426+ C9CA 3E 02                ld a,SFX_LASER                  ; a new pulse: its zap
1427+ C9CC 32 67 3A             ld (sfx_req),a
1428+ C9CF 21 15 D2     .beam:  ld hl,las_on
1429+ C9D2 35                   dec (hl)
1430+ C9D3 20 05                jr nz,.on
1431+ C9D5 3E 08                ld a,LASER_COOL                 ; last beam frame: cool down next
1432+ C9D7 32 16 D2             ld (las_cool),a
1433+ C9DA DD 21 68 B3  .on:    ld ix,laser_rec
1434+ C9DE 21 00 06             ld hl,LASER_RANGE
1435+ C9E1 CD A3 C6             call spawn_round                ; (start of path = the muzzle)
1436+ C9E4 DD 36 19 01          ld (ix+B_DMG),LASER_DMG         ; per beam frame on a target
1437+ C9E8 CD 33 CB             call bullet_step                ; trace it to the first thing it meets
1438+ C9EB DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+B_STATE)
1439+ C9EE B7                   or a
1440+ C9EF C8                   ret z                           ; off the map (can't, inside the wall)
1441+ C9F0 DD 36 00 03          ld (ix+B_STATE),3               ; beam
1442+ C9F4 C9                   ret

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - main menu (8K page PAGE_MENU, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Shown after start-up.  Layer 2 is hidden and the menu is drawn on the ULA
   5+ C000              ; screen with opaque paper.  Every frame it advances the random number
   6+ C000              ; generator (zrand), so the game doesn't start from the same seed each time
   7+ C000              ; (the wait for a key press varies), then reads the keys:
   8+ C000              ;   1  New game   -> newGame (zpolice.asm): level 1
   9+ C000              ;   2  Continue   -> the save game (made by save and quit, from the pause:
  10+ C000              ;                 game_pause), its level at its wave (load_save,
  11+ C000              ;                 continue_game, zpolice.asm); NO SAVED GAME if there's none
  12+ C000              ;   9  Redefine keys -> keydef_screen (keydef.asm)
  13+ C000              ; game_over_screen (the landing pad destroyed) shows GAME OVER for 10
  14+ C000              ; seconds, then returns here.

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - level loading (8K page PAGE_LEVEL, game logic: runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6; it pages the file handler, PAGE_FILE, into slot 7)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Each level is a file, ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL, naming its city, ZPDATA/CITYnn.ZPC
   6+ C000              ; (both made by gentables.py; the formats are described there).  A city is
   7+ C000              ; played for several levels.  load_level reads both:
   8+ C000              ;   * the level record into level_cur (levels.asm): city name, zombie and
   9+ C000              ;     wave counts, the draw distance, ...;
  10+ C000              ;   * the city into the city bank (page 7, slot 3): city_col at $6000 and
  11+ C000              ;     city_map at $7000, one 8K read;
  12+ C000              ;   * the level's own map changes (x, z, cell code, city_col), for hand-made
  13+ C000              ;     layouts;
  14+ C000              ;   * the city's palette and sky colour into the Layer 2 palette, then the
  15+ C000              ;     level's own palette over it, if it has one (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP);
  16+ C000              ;   * view_r / dot_r from the draw distance (2..VIEW_R tiles).
  17+ C000              ; Loading the map also clears every cell's zombie and human marks.  The
  18+ C000              ; files must be in the ZPDATA folder beside zpolice.nex on the SD card.
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              ; Level file
  22+ C000              LVF_CITY        equ 5               ; city number
  23+ C000              LVF_REC         equ 6               ; the level record (LV_SIZE bytes)
  24+ C000              LVF_NCHG        equ LVF_REC+LV_SIZE ; number of map changes,
  25+ C000              LVF_CHG         equ LVF_NCHG+1      ; then x, z, cell code, city_col each
  26+ C000              LVF_CHG_MAX     equ 64
  27+ C000              LVF_MAX         equ LVF_CHG+4*LVF_CHG_MAX
  28+ C000              ; City file
  29+ C000              CTF_SKY         equ 14              ; sky colour: RRRGGGBB, low blue bit
  30+ C000              CTF_PAL         equ 32              ; the palette, 256 pairs
  31+ C000              CTF_DATA        equ CTF_PAL+512     ; then city_col, city_map
  32+ C000              ; Level palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP, optional: tools/levelpal.py)
  33+ C000              LPF_PAL         equ 8               ; the palette, 256 pairs
  34+ C000              LPF_SIZE        equ LPF_PAL+512
  35+ C000              LEVEL_VERSION   equ 2               ; the files' format versions (+4): the
  36+ C000              CITY_VERSION    equ 1               ;   level file's 2 (specials by wave)
  37+ C000              LPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  38+ C000              ; Vision palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPV: tools/visionpal.py)
  39+ C000              VPF_PAL         equ 8               ; 4 palettes (VM_MODES), 256 pairs each
  40+ C000              VPF_SIZE        equ VPF_PAL+4*512
  41+ C000              VPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  42+ C000              LDERR_BADFILE   equ 255             ; error code: not a valid file
  43+ C000
  44+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  45+ C000              ; A = level (1..99): load it.  Carry set on failure, A = the esxDOS error
  46+ C000              ; code or LDERR_BADFILE.  Leaves PAGE_FILE in slot 7.
  47+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48+ C000              load_level:
  49+ C000 0E 2F                ld c,'0'-1                      ; the level's two digits
  50+ C002 0C           .tens:  inc c
  51+ C003 D6 0A                sub 10
  52+ C005 30 FB                jr nc,.tens
  53+ C007 C6 3A                add a,'0'+10
  54+ C009 32 6B C2             ld (ll_level+13),a
  55+ C00C 79                   ld a,c
  56+ C00D 32 6A C2             ld (ll_level+12),a
  57+ C010 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
  58+ C014 21 5E C2             ld hl,ll_level                  ; the level file
  59+ C017 11 C2 CA             ld de,ll_lbuf
  60+ C01A 01 78 01             ld bc,LVF_MAX
  61+ C01D CD 81 E0             call fh_load
  62+ C020 D8                   ret c
  63+ C021 21 C2 CA             ld hl,ll_lbuf
  64+ C024 11 96 C2             ld de,ll_lmagic
  65+ C027 0E 02                ld c,LEVEL_VERSION
  66+ C029 CD C0 C1             call ll_check
  67+ C02C D8                   ret c
  68+ C02D 21 C8 CA             ld hl,ll_lbuf+LVF_REC           ; its record
  69+ C030 11 5B A0             ld de,level_cur
  70+ C033 01 71 00             ld bc,LV_SIZE
  71+ C036 ED B0                ldir
  72+ C038 3A C7 CA             ld a,(ll_lbuf+LVF_CITY)         ; its city file: two digits
  73+ C03B 0E 2F                ld c,'0'-1

  75+ C03E D6 0A                sub 10
  76+ C040 30 FB                jr nc,.ctens
  77+ C042 C6 3A                add a,'0'+10
  78+ C044 32 7D C2             ld (ll_city+12),a
  79+ C047 79                   ld a,c

  81+ C04B 21 71 C2             ld hl,ll_city

  83+ C050 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
  84+ C053 D8                   ret c
  85+ C054 21 3A CC             ld hl,ll_cbuf                   ; header and palette
  86+ C057 01 20 02             ld bc,CTF_DATA
  87+ C05A CD 2E E0             call fh_read

  89+ C060 3A 17 E1             ld a,(fh_handle)                ; city_col and city_map: the whole
  90+ C063 21 00 60             ld hl,city_col                  ; city bank, in one read
  91+ C066 01 00 20             ld bc,2*GRID*GRID

  95+ C070 FE 20                cp high (2*GRID*GRID)

   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - load-out screen (8K page PAGE_LOADOUT, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Before the first level (newGame) and between levels, after LEVEL COMPLETE
   5+ C000              ; (loadout_go pages it in).  On the
   6+ C000              ; left, the store: every weapon type unlocked (wpn_unlocked) with the number
   7+ C000              ; in store (wpn_stock), even 0 when the only one is fitted.  On the right,
   8+ C000              ; the VTOL's 5 weapon slots and what is fitted in each.
   9+ C000              ;   1-5    select a slot (yellow)
  10+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the store list.  The highlighted
  11+ C000              ;          weapon is green if it can be fitted in the selected slot (the
  12+ C000              ;          slot allows it, wpn_fits, and one is in store), red if not; the
  13+ C000              ;          rest of the list is white.
  14+ C000              ;   SPACE  fit the highlighted weapon in the selected slot, if it can be:
  15+ C000              ;          one comes out of the store, with a full load (WCFG_LOAD), and
  16+ C000              ;          whatever was fitted there goes back into the store
  17+ C000              ;   U      unload the selected slot: its weapon back into the store, the
  18+ C000              ;          slot EMPTY (lo_unload)

  20+ C000              ;          (the centre slot); while it is empty 0: START LEVEL is red
  21+ C000              ; Uses the resident text routines (text.asm) and the keys page in slot 7.

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - redefine keys screen (8K page PAGE_KEYDEF, runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; From the main menu (option 9, keydef_go pages it in).  Lists every control
   6+ C000              ; (K_ACTIONS of them) with its key (key_defs) and its joystick input
   7+ C000              ; (joy_defs, "-" for none; input.asm).
   8+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the list (white; highlighted green);
   9+ C000              ;          KD_VIS rows of it show, scrolling to keep the highlight in view
  10+ C000              ;   SPACE  "PRESS A KEY OR JOYSTICK", a second's pause, then the next input
  11+ C000              ;          becomes the highlighted control's key, or its joystick input if
  12+ C000              ;          it is a joystick's, unless another control already uses it: then
  13+ C000              ;          "KEY ALREADY IN USE" (for a second) and no change
  14+ C000              ;   0      every key and joystick input back to its default (key_defaults,
  15+ C000              ;          joy_defaults)
  16+ C000              ;   1      back to the main menu (menu_go), saving the definitions first if
  17+ C000              ;          they changed (kd_save; "KEYS NOT SAVED" for a second if they
  18+ C000              ;          couldn't be)
  19+ C000              ; These keys are fixed (key_code_pressed), whatever the controls are set to.
  20+ C000              ; Uses the resident text routines (text.asm) and the input page in slot 7.
  21+ C000              ;
  22+ C000              ; The definitions are kept on the SD card as ZPDATA/KEYS.ZPK (beside the level
  23+ C000              ; files): "ZPKY", KF_VERSION, K_ACTIONS, then key_defs and joy_defs (2 bytes
  24+ C000              ; each control).  start loads them (kd_load, with this page in slot 6), if the
  25+ C000              ; file is there and fits this game: else the defaults.
  26+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  27+ C000

  29+ C000              KD_NAME_COL     equ 1               ; control names,

 382+ C26C C9                   ret

 384+ C26D              ; At start-up (this page in slot 6, the file handler set up): the saved
 385+ C26D              ; definitions, if the file is there and fits this game (its size, magic,

# file opened: specials.asm
   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - special monsters (8K page PAGE_SPECIAL, game logic: runs at
   3+ C000              ; $C000 in slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Special monsters use the zombie records after the zombies' own (NZOMB ..
   6+ C000              ; NMON-1, zombie.asm), so they share the zombies' drawing (zombie_cell,
   7+ C000              ; fig_draw), map blips, cell marks (zflags), weapon hits and zdamage.  The
   8+ C000              ; record's type (+15) says which monster it is.  Each wave's specials come
   9+ C000              ; from the level file (level_cur, LV_WAVE_DATA: up to LV_SPEC_SLOTS types,
  10+ C000              ; SPEC_*, and how many of each), placed by spec_wave as the wave starts;
  11+ C000              ; the level's start is wave 1 (spec_init).  spec_update moves them each
  12+ C000              ; frame, after zombie_update.
  13+ C000              ;
  14+ C000              ; The ghost (ZT_GHOST, special monster id SPEC_GHOST): a stick man under a white
  15+ C000              ; sheet.  It can't attack the base.  It flies at twice the zombies' speed,
  16+ C000              ; at any angle, and up and down between the ground and the VTOL's ceiling
  17+ C000              ; (MAX_Y), over buildings lower than it.
  18+ C000              ;   * Roaming: it flies in a random direction (a random climb or descent
  19+ C000              ;     too) until something makes it turn: a building in the way or the map
  20+ C000              ;     edge (a new random direction at once), or, at its decision check
  21+ C000              ;     every GHOST_DECIDE (30) frames, a human or the VTOL within GHOST_SEE
  22+ C000              ;     (3 tiles) that it can see.
  23+ C000              ;   * Chasing: it flies straight at the nearest one it can see, aiming
  24+ C000              ;     again every GHOST_TRACK (5) frames.  If it loses sight of its target
  25+ C000              ;     (behind a taller building) or the target is gone, it roams again in a
  26+ C000              ;     random direction, back on the 30-frame cycle.
  27+ C000              ;   * Attacking: within ATTACK_R (0.1 tile) of its target on each axis it
  28+ C000              ;     stops and takes GHOST_DMG hit point every GHOST_HIT_FRAMES (10)
  29+ C000              ;     frames: from a human (HUMAN_HP) until it dies, or from the VTOL
  30+ C000              ;     (vtol_hp, VTOL_HP; at 0 it is destroyed and the game ends).  Its map blip is red
  31+ C000              ;     meanwhile (zatk_flags, zblip_red), as an attacking zombie's.  If the
  32+ C000              ;     target moves out of reach it chases it again; once the human is dead
  33+ C000              ;     it roams again.
  34+ C000              ;   * It has GHOST_HP (10) hit points; any weapon can shoot it.  Killed, it
  35+ C000              ;     fades out where it is, white to near black in 4 steps of 3 frames
  36+ C000              ;     (GM_DYING; zdamage starts it, zombie_draw colours it, g_dying ends
  37+ C000              ;     it), and can't be hit meanwhile.
  38+ C000              ; Ghost record fields, besides the zombies' (zombie.asm):
  39+ C000              ;   +11 frames to its next decision check, +16 mode (GM_*), +17 frames to
  40+ C000              ;   its next blow, +18 hit points, +21,+22 height of its feet, +23,+24 and
  41+ C000              ;   +25,+26 velocity x, z (signed 8.8 units a frame), +27,+28 the x and z
  42+ C000              ;   position fractions, +29 climb (signed units a frame), +30 target
  43+ C000              ;   (TG_NONE, TG_VTOL, or a human's index).
  44+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  45+ C000
  46+ C000              GHOST_HP        equ 10              ; hit points
  47+ C000              GHOST_DECIDE    equ 30              ; frames between decisions while roaming
  48+ C000              GHOST_TRACK     equ 5               ; and while chasing
  49+ C000              GHOST_SEE       equ 3*TILE_UNITS    ; it spots humans / the VTOL this near
  50+ C000              GHOST_HIT_FRAMES equ 10             ; frames between blows
  51+ C000              GHOST_DMG       equ 1               ; hit points a blow
  52+ C000              GHOST_CLIMB     equ 1               ; units a frame up or down
  53+ C000              GHOST_AIM_MIN   equ 80              ; (aiming: nearer counts as this far)
  54+ C000              GM_ROAM         equ 0               ; modes (+16)
  55+ C000              GM_CHASE        equ 1
  56+ C000              GM_ATTACK       equ 2
  57+ C000              GM_DYING        equ 3               ; killed: fading out (+17 frames left)
  58+ C000              GHOST_FADE_FRAMES equ 12            ; the fade: 4 steps of 3 frames
  59+ C000              TG_NONE         equ $FF             ; targets (+30)
  60+ C000              TG_VTOL         equ $FE
  61+ C000              TG_BASE         equ $C0             ; + a base tile's index (base_hp, 0..24)
  62+ C000              ; The banshee (ZT_BANSHEE, id SPEC_BANSHEE): a ghost that flies twice as
  63+ C000              ; fast, reaches BANSHEE_R (0.5 tile), does BANSHEE_DMG a blow and also
  64+ C000              ; attacks the base (the terrace and pad tiles).
  65+ C000              ; The ghoul (ZT_GHOUL, id SPEC_GHOUL, zombie.asm): a half-height zombie
  66+ C000              ; walking at five times the zombies' speed.  It is placed here (spec_wave)
  67+ C000              ; but moved, drawn and hit as a zombie.
  68+ C000              ; (Which waves have which is the level files' business: gentables.py.)
  69+ C000              BANSHEE_HP      equ 8
  70+ C000              BANSHEE_DMG     equ 5
  71+ C000              BANSHEE_R       equ TILE_UNITS/2
  72+ C000              BASE_TILES      equ (2*TERRACE_R+1)*(2*TERRACE_R+1)
  73+ C000

  75+ C000              ; A level's start: every special record inactive, then wave 1's specials

# file opened: zombie.asm
   1+ 2000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 2000              ; Z-POLICE - zombie page (8K page PAGE_ZOMBIE, mapped at $2000 in MMU slot 1)
   3+ 2000              ;
   4+ 2000              ; Placeholder zombies: Layer 2 stick-man silhouettes walking the streets.
   5+ 2000              ; The page stays mapped at $2000 the whole time (slot 0 is used for paging
   6+ 2000              ; Layer 2 sections, slot 7 for the other code pages), so the city page can
   7+ 2000              ; call in here while it draws.
   8+ 2000              ;
   9+ 2000              ; Each zombie is a ZREC-byte record:
  10+ 2000              ;   +0,+1  x  8.8 fixed point in cell units (high byte = cell, low = fraction;
  11+ 2000              ;             the same as world units, one cell = 256)
  12+ 2000              ;   +2,+3  z  likewise
  13+ 2000              ;   +4     heading 0 = +z, 1 = +x, 2 = -z, 3 = -x  (yaw angle = heading*64;
  14+ 2000              ;             heading+1 turns right, heading+3 turns left)
  15+ 2000              ;   +5     walk animation phase 0..3
  16+ 2000              ;   +6     step accumulator: fraction of a world unit (4 bits)
  17+ 2000              ;   +7     wait: frames left standing still (0 = walking)
  18+ 2000              ;   +8,+9  cell (x, z) of the last turn decision ($FF = none)
  19+ 2000              ;   +10    active: 1 = in play, 0 = gone (not moved, linked or drawn)
  20+ 2000              ;   +11    frames until this zombie's next decision check
  21+ 2000              ;   +12,+13  cell (x, z) of its blip on the street map
  22+ 2000              ;   +14    1 = blip plotted
  23+ 2000              ;   +15    type: 0 = zombie, 1 = fast zombie (walks at twice the speed),
  24+ 2000              ;          ZT_GHOUL (a special: 5x, half height), ZT_GHOST, ZT_BANSHEE
  25+ 2000              ;   +16    mode: 0 = walking, 1 = going for a base tile, 2 = attacking it
  26+ 2000              ;   +17    frames to its next hit on the tile
  27+ 2000              ;   +18    hit points left (ZHP, ZHP_FAST; weapons.asm zdamage)
  28+ 2000              ;   +19,+20  cell (x, z) marked with CELL_ZOMBIE in city_map ($FF = none)
  29+ 2000              ;   +21,+22  height of its feet (0 for zombies; special monsters fly)
  30+ 2000              ;   +23..+30 special monsters' own fields (specials.asm)
  31+ 2000              ;   +31    1 = drawn last frame (fig_seen; cleared by lock_update, weapons.asm)
  32+ 2000              ;   +32,+33  where: the centre column and row on the view (the missile lock)
  33+ 2000              ; Records 0..NZOMB-1 are the zombies, NZOMB..NMON-1 the special monsters
  34+ 2000              ; (specials.asm), which share the drawing, cell marks, map blips and weapon
  35+ 2000              ; hits; their type (+15) says which.
  36+ 2000              ; zatk_flags (one byte per zombie, by index): TRUE while it attacks a base
  37+ 2000              ; tile, when its map dot is red; FALSE again once the tile is destroyed.
  38+ 2000              ;
  39+ 2000              ; The base: at junctions a zombie leans towards the road that points at the
  40+ 2000              ; landing pad (zbias_t, from the level).  A base tile (terrace or pad) in its
  41+ 2000              ; way isn't avoided: it walks up to ATTACK_R from it and hits it every
  42+ 2000              ; ZHIT_FRAMES frames.  A destroyed terrace tile becomes road and the zombie
  43+ 2000              ; walks on; the pad destroyed sets game_over.
  44+ 2000              ;
  45+ 2000              ; Street map blips: zblip / zblip_off (map.asm) are called on the zombie's
  46+ 2000              ; decision-check frames.  Call zblip_off for a zombie before making it gone.
  47+ 2000              ;
  48+ 2000              ; Decisions are staggered: each active zombie only checks for junctions and
  49+ 2000              ; obstacles once every zsteps frames, with the zombies' check frames spread
  50+ 2000              ; out so only about NZOMB/zsteps of them check on any one frame.  In between
  51+ 2000              ; they just walk, so the look-ahead (zlook) covers zsteps frames of walking
  52+ 2000              ; plus a margin: ZMARGIN + zsteps*zspeed/16.
  53+ 2000              ;
  54+ 2000              ; Movement (zmove), every frame:
  55+ 2000              ;   * Standing still: count the wait down and do nothing else.
  56+ 2000              ;   * Not this zombie's check frame: step forwards (see the last point).
  57+ 2000              ;   * Junctions: once per cell, when the zombie is 0.25-0.75 of the way
  58+ 2000              ;     through the cell along its heading, look for a road (street cell) to
  59+ 2000              ;     the left and to the right.  Left is tested first: if there is a road,
  60+ 2000              ;     turn left at random (1 in 2); if not taken, the same for the right.
  61+ 2000              ;     The cell is then marked as decided, so it isn't tested again until the
  62+ 2000              ;     zombie has been somewhere else.
  63+ 2000              ;   * Blocked (building or map edge within zlook ahead): turn left if there
  64+ 2000              ;     is a road there, else right; otherwise turn round and stand still for
  65+ 2000              ;     ZWAIT frames before testing anything again.
  66+ 2000              ;   * Otherwise step forwards zspeed/16 world units (the remainder is kept,
  67+ 2000              ;     so slow speeds still move smoothly on average).
  68+ 2000              ;
  69+ 2000              ; Zombies are only ever on street (empty) cells.  They are drawn by the city
  70+ 2000              ; traversal when it reaches their cell (draw_cell jumps to zombie_cell for
  71+ 2000              ; empty cells), so the painter's algorithm hides them behind nearer buildings.
  72+ 2000              ; A cell holding zombies has bit 7 (CELL_ZOMBIE) of its city_map byte set,
  73+ 2000              ; by zflags every frame; zombie_cell then searches the records for them.
  74+ 2000              ;
  75+ 2000              ; Sprites (tables_zombie.inc, generated): 8 scales from 1x4 to 8x16 pixels,
  76+ 2000              ; forward and left facings, 4 walk frames.  Rear and right are the mirrored
  77+ 2000              ; forward and left.  One byte per row, bit 7 = leftmost pixel.
  78+ 2000              ;==============================================================================
  79+ 2000
  80+ 2000              NZOMB           equ 30          ; zombie records: the most in a wave
  81+ 2000              NSPEC           equ 8           ; most special monsters (5 ghosts, banshees)
  82+ 2000              NMON            equ NZOMB+NSPEC ; records: zombies, then special monsters
  83+ 2000              ZREC            equ 34          ; bytes per record
  84+ 2000              ZT_FAST         equ 1           ; +15: fast zombie
  85+ 2000              ZT_GHOUL        equ 2           ; +15: a ghoul: a special monster that walks
  86+ 2000                                              ; as a zombie (zmove), half height, 5x speed
  87+ 2000              ZT_GHOST        equ 3           ; +15: a ghost (specials.asm); types from
  88+ 2000              ZT_BANSHEE      equ 4           ; here on fly (specials.asm moves them)
  89+ 2000              ZHP             equ 5           ; hit points: a zombie (level 1)
  90+ 2000              ZHP_FAST        equ 4           ; and a fast zombie
  91+ 2000              GHOUL_HP        equ ZHP         ; and a ghoul
  92+ 2000              ZSPEED_INIT     equ 10          ; starting zspeed: 0.63 units (4.9 cm) per
  93+ 2000                                              ; frame, ~0.7 m/s at 14 fps
  94+ 2000              ZSTEPS_INIT     equ 10          ; starting zsteps: decide every 10 frames
  95+ 2000              ZMARGIN         equ 16          ; keep at least this far from walls: 1.25 m
  96+ 2000              ZWAIT           equ 100         ; frames to stand still when stuck
  97+ 2000              ZOMBIE_H        equ 26          ; height: 2 m (the same as the hit box, ZHIT_H)

   1+ 2E1D              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 2E1D              ; Z-POLICE - humans to rescue (in the zombie page, after zombie.asm: kept
   3+ 2E1D              ; mapped in slot 1)
   4+ 2E1D              ;
   5+ 2E1D              ; Up to HUMAN_MAX humans, nhumans of them placed at random at start-up (on a
   6+ 2E1D              ; road, or on a roof low enough to land on).  They stand facing the player,
   7+ 2E1D              ; and wave their right arm while the VTOL is within WAVE_R.  On the city map
   8+ 2E1D              ; each is a blue dot, flashing 3 frames on, 3 off.
   9+ 2E1D              ;
  10+ 2E1D              ; Fleeing (hum_flee): a human on the road (never one on a roof) with a
  11+ 2E1D              ; monster within FLEE_R runs from the nearest one for FLEE_TIME frames, at
  12+ 2E1D              ; HUMAN_FLEE units a frame, then looks again.  Its way is picked at random
  13+ 2E1D              ; of the two that take it away from the monster (along x or along z); if
  14+ 2E1D              ; that way is blocked (a building, the base, the wall) it takes the other,
  15+ 2E1D              ; and if both are, it stands.  It only runs along roads.
  16+ 2E1D              ;
  17+ 2E1D              ; Base: landed on the landing pad (map code PAD_CODE), the passengers get off
  18+ 2E1D              ; one every DISEMBARK frames (a second) and are counted as saved.
  19+ 2E1D              ;
  20+ 2E1D              ; Rescue: when the craft has landed (speed 0, resting on the road or on the
  21+ 2E1D              ; roof under it), carries fewer than PASSENGER_MAX and a human stands within
  22+ 2E1D              ; RESCUE_R at the same height (a roof of the same height, or the road), the
  23+ 2E1D              ; human runs to it at HUMAN_RUN units a frame and climbs in.  A human on a
  24+ 2E1D              ; taller or lower roof cannot be reached.
  25+ 2E1D              ;
  26+ 2E1D              ; Each human is an HREC-byte record:
  27+ 2E1D              ;   +0,+1  x  (world units: high byte = cell, as for zombies)
  28+ 2E1D              ;   +2,+3  z
  29+ 2E1D              ;   +4,+5  y  height of its feet (roof height, or 0 on the road)
  30+ 2E1D              ;   +6     state (HS_*): 0 unused, 1 waiting in the city, 2 aboard the
  31+ 2E1D              ;          VTOL, 3 rescued (off at the landing pad), 4 dead
  32+ 2E1D              ;   +7,+8  cell (x, z) of its map dot
  33+ 2E1D              ;   +9     1 = map dot shown
  34+ 2E1D              ;   +10    hit points left (HUMAN_HP; a rocket blast, weapons.asm)
  35+ 2E1D              ;   +11,+12  cell (x, z) marked with CELL_HUMAN in city_map ($FF = none)
  36+ 2E1D              ;   +13    how it's drawn this frame: 0 standing, HUM_WAVING waving, or
  37+ 2E1D              ;          running (to the VTOL, or fleeing): its way + 1 (1 +z, 2 +x,
  38+ 2E1D              ;          3 -z, 4 -x, as a zombie's heading + 1)
  39+ 2E1D              ;   +14    fleeing: frames left (0: not fleeing)
  40+ 2E1D              ;   +15    fleeing: its way + 1 (as +13)
  41+ 2E1D              ;
  42+ 2E1D              ; Drawing: draw_cell (city page) tests the cell's CELL_HUMAN mark in
  43+ 2E1D              ; city_map (bit 6, set by hum_flags) and draws them with human_cell: after
  44+ 2E1D              ; the building on whose roof they stand, so the roof doesn't cover them.  With
  45+ 2E1D              ; OCCLUSION_CULL the cell goes on the draw list instead (as its city_col
  46+ 2E1D              ; address, $6000-$6FFF) and is drawn from there.
  47+ 2E1D              ;==============================================================================
  48+ 2E1D
  49+ 2E1D              HREC            equ 16
  50+ 2E1D              HUM_WAVING      equ 5               ; +13: waving (above the 4 ways)
  51+ 2E1D              HS_NONE         equ 0               ; human states (+6)
  52+ 2E1D              HS_WAIT         equ 1               ; waiting in the city to be rescued
  53+ 2E1D              HS_ABOARD       equ 2               ; aboard the VTOL
  54+ 2E1D              HS_SAVED        equ 3               ; rescued: off at the landing pad
  55+ 2E1D              HS_DEAD         equ 4               ; killed (a rocket blast, a ghost)
  56+ 2E1D

   2+ 34DC              ; Z-POLICE - city map (in the zombie page, after human.asm: kept mapped in
   3+ 34DC              ; slot 1)
   4+ 34DC              ;
   5+ 34DC              ; Everything that draws the GRID x GRID city map at the right of the
   6+ 34DC              ; instrument panel (pixel columns MAP_X.., rows 128-191, one pixel per cell,
   7+ 34DC              ; north up):
   8+ 34DC              ;   * map_init / map_l2: the map itself, drawn once at start-up into both
   9+ 34DC              ;     Layer 2 buffers, and the ULA set-up over it (called from ula_init);
  10+ 34DC              ;   * map_player: the player's flashing white dot, on the ULA (draw_hud);
  11+ 34DC              ;   * zblip / zblip_off: zombie blips, bright green (zombie.asm, weapons.asm);
  12+ 34DC              ;   * hum_dots / hum_dot: humans' flashing blue dots (human.asm);
  13+ 34DC              ;   * map_pix / map_under: set one map cell's pixel in both Layer 2 buffers,
  14+ 34DC              ;     and the colour the map itself has there.
  15+ 34DC              ; Page 7 is always mapped, so all the pages above can call in here.
  16+ 34DC              ;==============================================================================
  17+ 34DC
  18+ 34DC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  19+ 34DC              ; City map: GRID x GRID cells at one pixel each (64x64), north up, at pixel
  20+ 34DC              ; columns MAP_X.. and rows 128-191.  It is drawn on Layer 2, into both
  21+ 34DC              ; buffers once (the viewport clear only touches rows 0-127), so each
  22+ 34DC              ; building can be its own colour; zombie blips and human dots are written
  23+ 34DC              ; into it too.  The ULA above it is transparent paper with white ink for the
  24+ 34DC              ; player's flashing dot.

 131+ 3582              ; Zombie blips: each zombie is one bright green (MAP_ZOMBIE) pixel at its cell,

2032  3689                      INCLUDE "interrupts.asm"        ; IM 2 vector table and routine
# file opened: interrupts.asm
   1+ 3689              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 3689              ; Z-POLICE - interrupt mode 2 (in the zombie page, after map.asm: kept
   3+ 3689              ; mapped in slot 1, so the table and routine are there whatever page is
   4+ 3689              ; swapped in; the ROM replaces slot 1 only during esxDOS calls, when
   5+ 3689              ; interrupts are off)
   6+ 3689              ;
   7+ 3689              ; In IM 2 an interrupt calls the address held in the word at I*256 + the
   8+ 3689              ; byte on the data bus, which can be anything.  So:
   9+ 3689              ;   * im2_table is 256 words, every one the address of im2_routine, at a
  10+ 3689              ;     256-byte boundary (I holds the high byte of its address): any bus
  11+ 3689              ;     byte, even $FF (bytes $FF and $100), reads a word inside it;
  12+ 3689              ;   * an odd bus byte reads a word that straddles two entries, low byte
  13+ 3689              ;     from one and high byte from the next, so im2_routine sits at an
  14+ 3689              ;     address whose high and low bytes are the same (IM2_ROUTINE, $xyxy):
  15+ 3689              ;     read either way round, it's the same address.
  16+ 3689              ; im2_init sets I and IM 2 (start calls it after init_audio); start enables
  17+ 3689              ; interrupts just before the main menu, and they stay on, 50 a second, except:
  18+ 3689              ;   * over esxDOS calls (fh_rom_in / fh_rom_out): the ROM covers slot 1, this
  19+ 3689              ;     page, so they are off and put back as they were;
  20+ 3689              ;   * the span filler borrows SP (city.asm: PUSHes into Layer 2, slot 0).  An
  21+ 3689              ;     interrupt there pushes its return address just below SP: into the
  22+ 3689              ;     part of the span still to be filled, which the PUSHes then overwrite.
  23+ 3689              ;     Interrupts are off from just before a span's last PUSH until SP is
  24+ 3689              ;     back (push_blk), and a 1-pixel span doesn't borrow SP at all.
  25+ 3689              ; The routine switches to its own stack at once, keeps every register, and
  26+ 3689              ; touches only the AY ports (never $243B, the main code's NextReg port), and
  27+ 3689              ; only while the engines are on (eng_on): code outside the interrupt writes
  28+ 3689              ; the AY chips only with eng_on 0 (init_audio, engine_start).
  29+ 3689              ;==============================================================================
  30+ 3689
  31+ 3689              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  32+ 3689              ; Point I at the vector table and select interrupt mode 2.  (start enables
  33+ 3689              ; interrupts later.)
  34+ 3689              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  35+ 3689              im2_init:
  36+ 3689 3E 37                ld a,high im2_table
  37+ 368B ED 47                ld i,a
  38+ 368D ED 5E                im 2
  39+ 368F C9                   ret

  52+ 3939              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  53+ 3939              ; The interrupt routine, each video frame (50 a second): the engines' sound
  54+ 3939              ; (engine_tick) and the sound effects (sfx_tick).  On its own stack: SP may
  55+ 3939              ; be the span filler's.  It must never use the alternate registers (EXX,
  56+ 3939              ; EX AF,AF'): the city's cell walks keep their place in HL', DE' across
  57+ 3939              ; the whole drawing (draw_row, city.asm).
  58+ 3939              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  59+ 3939              im2_routine:
  60+ 3939 ED 73 73 3A          ld (isr_sp),sp                  ; its own stack at once (no PUSH on
  61+ 393D 31 95 3A             ld sp,isr_stack                 ; a borrowed one)
  62+ 3940 F5                   push af
  63+ 3941 C5                   push bc
  64+ 3942 D5                   push de
  65+ 3943 E5                   push hl
  66+ 3944 CD 55 39             call engine_tick
  67+ 3947 CD 07 3A             call sfx_tick
  68+ 394A E1                   pop hl
  69+ 394B D1                   pop de
  70+ 394C C1                   pop bc
  71+ 394D F1                   pop af
  72+ 394E ED 7B 73 3A          ld sp,(isr_sp)
  73+ 3952 FB                   ei
  74+ 3953 ED 4D                reti
  75+ 3955                      ASSERT im2_routine == IM2_ROUTINE
  76+ 3955                      ASSERT high im2_routine == low im2_routine
  77+ 3955
  78+ 3955              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  79+ 3955              ; The VTOL's engines (audio.asm has the sound's constants and engine_start):
  80+ 3955              ; jet turbines, on AY 1.  eng_cur is the speed the engines sound at, in
  81+ 3955              ; 1/ENG_FRAC steps; each interrupt it follows the VTOL's, n = |speed| (at
  82+ 3955              ; least 1: zero throttle idles as speed 1), by at most ENG_SPIN_UP going up
  83+ 3955              ; and ENG_SPIN_DOWN going down: the turbines spool up, and down more slowly,
  84+ 3955              ; instead of jumping.  From it:
  85+ 3955              ;   A  noise, the roar: period ENG_NOISE0 - m*13/16, volume ENG_ROAR_VOL0 +
  86+ 3955              ;      m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32

 204+ 3A07              ; Sound effects, three voices: the weapons on AY 2 (sfx_req), explosions on
 205+ 3A07              ; AY 3's channels A and B (sfx2_req), and splats on AY 3's channel C
 206+ 3A07              ; (sfx3_req: a tone only, as the chip's noise is the explosions'), so none

 209+ 3A07              ; engines have AY 1.  The game asks for a sound by putting its number in a
 210+ 3A07              ; voice's request byte (SFX_*, audio.asm): one byte, so safe from any page
 211+ 3A07              ; at any time; only the interrupt writes the AY chips.  Each voice plays one
 212+ 3A07              ; sound at a time: a new one cuts the last.  A sound is a list of steps, one
 213+ 3A07              ; an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value pairs, ended by
 214+ 3A07              ; SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (the sound is over).

# file opened: sprite_data.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - sprite pattern banks (8K pages, assembled at $E000)
   3+ E000              ;
   4+ E000              ; Hardware sprite patterns are only needed when they are loaded into the
   5+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory, so they live in their own pages, out of the way,
   6+ E000              ; each with its own loader so that no resident memory is used:
   7+ E000              ;
   8+ E000              ;       nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPR0      ; the bank into slot 7
   9+ E000              ;       call spr_load_bank              ; copy its patterns
  10+ E000              ;
  11+ E000              ; Call it from outside slot 7 (resident code or a game logic page in slot
  12+ E000              ; 6), and page back whatever slot 7 had afterwards if it is still needed.
  13+ E000              ; spr_load_bank is the same address ($E000) in every bank.
  14+ E000              ;
  15+ E000              ; Each bank (SPRBANK_ADDR = $E000):
  16+ E000              ;   +0          spr_load_bank: the loader (SPRB_LOADER), the same in each
  17+ E000              ;   SPRB_COUNT  number of patterns (1..31: 256 bytes each, 8-bit 16x16)
  18+ E000              ;   SPRB_FIRST  the pattern number the first one loads to (0..63)
  19+ E000              ;   SPRB_DATA   the patterns, one after another
  20+ E000              ; More sprites: add a bank (the next free page, its own PAGE_SPRn in
  21+ E000              ; memory_bank_defs.asm, the MMU / ORG lines in zpolice.asm and a block here
  22+ E000              ; starting with SPRB_LOADER).
  23+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  24+ E000
  25+ E000              ; Copy this bank's patterns into the sprite pattern memory.  Runs from the
  26+ E000              ; bank itself: reads only, so it needs no variables.
  27+ E000                      MACRO SPRB_LOADER
  28+ E000 ~                    ld a,(SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_FIRST)  ; from this pattern
